recipes.name: Smoked salmon blinis with lemon crème fraîche
recipes.method_note: Assemble no more than an hour ahead, or the blinis go soft.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C.
Lay {{ing:blinis}} on a baking tray.
Warm them in the oven for 4 minutes, until soft and warm.
Grate the zest of {{ing:lemon}} into a bowl.
Stir in {{ing:creme-fraiche}} and half of the {{ing:fresh-dill}}.
Squeeze in 1 tsp of the lemon juice. Stir.
Put a teaspoon of the cream on each blini.
Tear {{ing:smoked-salmon-cold}} into strips. Fold a strip onto each blini.
Finish with the rest of the dill and {{ing:black-pepper-ground}}.

swaps.text: Hot-smoked trout or cooked prawns
Thick oat-based crème fraîche, for a dairy-free version
Thin slices of cucumber or rye crackers, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Prawn cocktail
recipes.method_note: Dry the prawns well on kitchen paper or the sauce goes thin.

steps.instruction: Pat {{ing:prawns-cooked}} dry with kitchen paper.
steps.note: Frozen prawns need to thaw in the fridge overnight first.

steps.instruction: Mix {{ing:mayonnaise}}, {{ing:tomato-ketchup}} and {{ing:worcestershire-sauce}} in a bowl.
Squeeze in half of {{ing:lemon}}. Stir. Taste.
Stir the prawns into the sauce.
Shred {{ing:cos-lettuce}} finely.
Halve {{ing:avocado}}, remove the stone, then dice the flesh.
Divide the lettuce and avocado between four glasses or bowls.
Spoon the prawns on top.
Dust with {{ing:cayenne-pepper}}. Cut the other lemon half into wedges to serve.

swaps.text: Cooked crab meat, or chopped palm hearts for a vegan version with vegan mayonnaise
A few drops of soy sauce, as most Worcestershire sauce contains anchovy

recipes.name: Seared scallops with minted peas and crisp pancetta
recipes.method_note: A very hot pan and dry scallops give the golden crust. Do not move them while they sear.

steps.instruction: Put a pan of water on a high heat.
Boil {{ing:peas-frozen}} for 3 minutes, until bright green and tender.
Drain. Blend with {{ing:butter-block}} and {{ing:fresh-mint}} until nearly smooth.
Add a squeeze of {{ing:lemon}} and a pinch of salt. Keep warm.
Put a large frying pan on a medium heat.
Fry {{ing:pancetta}} for 5 minutes, until crisp. Lift onto kitchen paper.
Pat {{ing:scallops}} dry. Season both sides with salt.
Turn the heat to high. Add {{ing:olive-oil}} to the pan.
Lay the scallops in. Cook 90 seconds without moving them, until golden underneath.
Turn them over. Cook 1 minute more.
steps.note: They should still feel slightly springy.

steps.instruction: Spoon peas onto plates. Top with three scallops and the pancetta.

swaps.text: Toasted hazelnuts, chopped, for a version with no meat
Olive oil, to make it dairy free

recipes.name: Chicken liver pâté
recipes.method_note: Make it the day before. It sets in the fridge and the flavour is better.

steps.instruction: Trim any white sinew from {{ing:chicken-livers}}. Pat dry.
Melt 25 g of {{ing:butter-block}} in a frying pan on a medium heat.
Chop {{ing:shallot}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Fry 5 minutes, until soft.
Add the livers and leaves from {{ing:fresh-thyme}}. Fry 4 minutes, turning once.
steps.note: They should be brown outside and just pink in the middle. Overcooked livers taste grainy.

steps.instruction: Add {{ing:spirit-40}} (brandy). Let it bubble for 1 minute.
Tip everything into a blender with the rest of the butter.
Blend until smooth. Season with salt and pepper.
Spoon into a dish. Cover and chill for at least 4 hours.
Toast {{ing:bread-slice-medium}}. Cut into triangles.
Serve the pâté with the toast and {{ing:redcurrant-jelly}}.

swaps.text: Port, or 2 tbsp apple juice for no alcohol
Gluten-free toast or oatcakes labelled gluten free

recipes.name: Beetroot, goats' cheese and walnut salad
recipes.method_note: Vacuum-packed cooked beetroot works perfectly here.

steps.instruction: Put a dry frying pan on a medium heat.
Toast {{ing:walnuts}} for 3 minutes, until they smell nutty.
Add {{ing:honey}}. Stir 1 minute until coated. Tip onto baking paper.
Cut cooked {{ing:beetroot}} into wedges.
Whisk {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:balsamic-vinegar}} with a pinch of salt.
Toss {{ing:rocket}} in half of the dressing. Divide between plates.
Add the beetroot. Crumble {{ing:goats-cheese}} over.
Scatter the walnuts. Drizzle the rest of the dressing.

swaps.text: Crumbled feta, or a vegan soft cheese for a vegan version
Maple syrup, for a vegan version
Toasted pumpkin seeds, for a nut-free version

recipes.name: Spiced parsnip and apple soup
recipes.method_note: Freezes well for up to three months.

steps.instruction: Put a large pan on a medium heat. Add {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Chop {{ing:onion-medium}}. Fry 8 minutes, until soft and see-through.
Crush {{ing:garlic-clove}} into the pan. Stir 1 minute.
Peel and chop {{ing:parsnip}} and {{ing:apple-medium}} into chunks.
Add them with {{ing:curry-powder}}. Stir 2 minutes.
Pour in {{ing:stock-vegetable}}. Bring to the boil.
Simmer (small bubbles) for 25 minutes, until the parsnip is soft.
Blend until smooth.
Stir in {{ing:oat-cream}}. Season with salt and pepper.
steps.note: Too thick? Add a splash of hot water.

swaps.text: Single cream
Ground cumin and a pinch of ground ginger

recipes.name: Thai crab cakes with lime leaf and sweet chilli
recipes.method_note: Chilling the cakes before frying stops them falling apart.

steps.instruction: Peel {{ing:potato-large}} and cut into chunks.
Boil 12 minutes, until soft. Drain and mash. Cool.
Remove the stalks from {{ing:lime-leaves}}. Shred the leaves very finely.
Peel the tough outer layer off {{ing:lemongrass}}. Chop the inside very finely.
Chop {{ing:chilli-fresh}}, {{ing:spring-onion}} and {{ing:fresh-coriander}}.
Mix it all into the potato with {{ing:crab-white-meat}} and {{ing:fish-sauce}}.
Shape into 8 small cakes.
Beat {{ing:egg-medium}}. Dip each cake in egg, then in {{ing:panko}}.
Chill for 30 minutes.
Heat {{ing:vegetable-oil}} in a frying pan on a medium heat.
Fry the cakes 3 minutes a side, until golden.
Serve with {{ing:sweet-chilli-sauce}} and wedges of {{ing:lime}}.

swaps.text: Cooked salmon or cooked prawns, chopped
Gluten-free breadcrumbs, for a gluten-free version (check the fish sauce too)
The grated zest of 1 lime

recipes.name: Mushroom and chestnut pâté
recipes.method_note: Cook the mushrooms until the pan is dry. Wet mushrooms make a loose pâté.

steps.instruction: Put a large frying pan on a medium heat. Add {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Chop {{ing:shallot}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Fry 5 minutes, until soft.
Slice {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}}. Add with leaves from {{ing:fresh-thyme}}.
Fry 12 minutes, until the liquid has gone and they are browning.
Add {{ing:sherry}}. Bubble 1 minute.
Blend with {{ing:chestnuts-cooked}} and {{ing:soy-sauce}} until nearly smooth.
Season. Spoon into a dish. Chill for 2 hours to firm up.
Serve with {{ing:oatcakes}}.

swaps.text: Apple juice, for no alcohol
Tamari labelled gluten free, with gluten-free oatcakes, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Stilton, pear and walnut tartlets
recipes.method_note: Ready-rolled pastry, straight from the fridge, is easiest to cut cleanly.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Line a baking tray with baking paper.
Unroll {{ing:puff-pastry}}. Cut into 6 rectangles. Put them on the tray.
Score a border 1 cm in from each edge, without cutting through.
steps.note: The border puffs up around the filling.

steps.instruction: Beat {{ing:egg-medium}}. Brush it over the borders.
Core {{ing:pear}} and slice thinly. Lay the slices inside the borders.
Crumble {{ing:stilton}} over. Scatter {{ing:walnuts}}.
Bake 18 minutes, until puffed and golden.
Drizzle with {{ing:honey}}. Scatter leaves from {{ing:fresh-thyme}}.

swaps.text: Soft goats' cheese, or a vegan blue-style cheese with vegan pastry
Leave them out for a nut-free version

recipes.name: Roast turkey crown with lemon and thyme
recipes.method_note: Resting for 30 minutes is part of the cooking. It keeps the meat juicy and frees the oven.

steps.instruction: Take {{ing:turkey-crown}} out of the fridge 1 hour before cooking.
steps.note: Cold meat cooks unevenly.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 190C.
Mash {{ing:butter-block}} with the zest of {{ing:lemon}} and leaves from {{ing:fresh-thyme}}.
Crush {{ing:garlic-clove}} into the butter. Add a good pinch of salt.
Push the butter under the skin, over the breast meat.
steps.note: Loosen the skin with your fingers from the neck end first.

steps.instruction: Thickly slice {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:carrot-medium}}. Spread in a roasting tin.
Sit the turkey on top. Pour {{ing:stock-chicken}} into the tin.
Roast 2 hours 10 minutes for a 2.5 kg crown.
steps.note: About 45 minutes per kg plus 20. Cover loosely with foil if the skin browns too fast.

steps.instruction: Check the thickest part reads 75C, or the juices run clear, not pink.
Lift onto a board. Cover loosely with foil. Rest 30 minutes.
Keep the tin and its juices for the gravy.

swaps.text: Olive oil with the same lemon, thyme and garlic, to make it dairy free
A whole turkey: roast 20 minutes per kg plus 90 minutes, and check the thigh

recipes.name: Honey and mustard glazed gammon
recipes.method_note: Simmer first, then glaze. Good hot on the day and cold on Boxing Day.

steps.instruction: Put {{ing:gammon-joint}} in a large pan. Cover with cold water.
Add {{ing:onion-medium}} cut in half, {{ing:bay-leaf}} and {{ing:black-peppercorns}}.
Bring to the boil, then simmer (small bubbles) for 1 hour 40 minutes.
steps.note: 50 minutes per kg. Skim off any froth.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Lift the gammon into a foil-lined roasting tin. Cool 10 minutes.
Cut off the skin, leaving a thin layer of fat.
Score the fat in diamonds. Push {{ing:cloves}} into the crossings.
Mix {{ing:honey}}, {{ing:mustard-dijon}} and {{ing:sugar-demerara}}. Brush over the fat.
Roast 25 minutes, until sticky and dark golden.
steps.note: Brush on more glaze halfway.

steps.instruction: Rest 15 minutes before carving.

swaps.text: Maple syrup
English mustard, for more heat (check the label if you need gluten free)

recipes.name: Beef fillet with green peppercorn sauce
recipes.method_note: A meat thermometer takes the guesswork out: 50C in the middle for medium-rare.

steps.instruction: Take {{ing:beef-fillet}} out of the fridge 1 hour before.
Heat the oven to 220C. Season the beef all over with salt.
Put a roasting tin on the hob on a high heat. Add {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Brown the beef on every side, 6 minutes in all.
Roast 20 minutes for medium-rare.
steps.note: 25 minutes for medium.

steps.instruction: Rest on a board under foil for 15 minutes.
Crumble {{ing:stock-cube}} into {{ing:water}} that has boiled. Stir.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}} in a frying pan on a medium heat.
Chop {{ing:shallot}} finely. Fry 4 minutes, until soft.
Add {{ing:spirit-40}} (brandy). Bubble until almost gone.
steps.note: Stand back: it can flame. If it does, let it burn out.

steps.instruction: Add the stock. Boil 5 minutes, until halved.
Drain {{ing:green-peppercorns-brine}}. Crush lightly. Add with {{ing:double-cream}} and {{ing:mustard-dijon}}.
Simmer 3 minutes, until it coats a spoon.
Slice the beef thickly. Serve with the sauce.

swaps.text: More stock with 1 tsp of red wine vinegar, for no alcohol
Oat cream, with olive oil for the butter, to make it dairy free
A gluten-free stock cube, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Slow-roast duck legs with orange and star anise
recipes.method_note: Slow cooking renders the fat and leaves the meat falling off the bone. Keep the fat for roast potatoes.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 160C.
Prick the skin of {{ing:duck-leg}} all over with a fork.
steps.note: Pricking lets the fat run out.

steps.instruction: Rub with {{ing:five-spice}} and a good pinch of salt.
Slice {{ing:orange}} into rounds. Lay them in a roasting tin.
Add {{ing:star-anise}}, {{ing:cinnamon-stick}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}}, lightly crushed.
Slice {{ing:ginger-fresh}}. Add to the tin with {{ing:stock-chicken}}.
Sit the legs on top, skin up.
Roast 2 hours, until the meat is very tender.
Mix {{ing:soy-sauce}} and {{ing:honey}}. Brush over the skin.
Turn the oven to 200C. Roast 15 minutes more, until crisp.
Spoon off the fat. Serve with the orange juices from the tin.

swaps.text: Tamari labelled gluten free, for a gluten-free version
Maple syrup

recipes.name: Baked side of salmon with lemon, dill and herb crumb
recipes.method_note: One whole side looks generous and cooks in 25 minutes.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Line a large tray with baking paper.
Lay {{ing:salmon-fillet}} skin down on the tray. Season.
Spread {{ing:mustard-dijon}} over the top.
Chop {{ing:fresh-dill}} and {{ing:fresh-parsley}}. Grate in the zest of {{ing:lemon}}.
Crush in {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Mix with {{ing:panko}} and {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Press the crumb over the salmon.
Bake 22 minutes, until it flakes in the thickest part.
Serve with the lemons cut into wedges.

swaps.text: Gluten-free breadcrumbs, or chopped pistachios, for a gluten-free version
A side of trout, baked for 15 minutes

recipes.name: Saffron fish and mussel stew
recipes.method_note: Add the fish at the end and let it poach gently, so it stays in large pieces.

steps.instruction: Soak {{ing:saffron}} in 3 tbsp of hot water from the kettle.
Put a wide pan on a medium heat. Add {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Chop {{ing:onion-medium}}. Fry 8 minutes, until soft.
Slice {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Add with {{ing:smoked-paprika}}. Stir 1 minute.
Pour in {{ing:wine-white}}. Bubble 2 minutes.
Add {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}}, the saffron and {{ing:water}}.
Crumble in {{ing:stock-cube}}. Simmer 15 minutes.
Cut {{ing:hake-fillet}} into large chunks. Lay them in the sauce.
Add {{ing:king-prawns-raw}} and {{ing:mussels-cooked}}. Cover.
Cook 5 minutes, until the prawns are pink and the fish flakes.
Scatter chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}}. Serve with crusty bread.

swaps.text: More water with a squeeze of lemon, for no alcohol
Cod, haddock or monkfish
Check the label says gluten free, if you need it

recipes.name: Lobster tails with garlic and herb butter
recipes.method_note: Frozen raw tails thaw overnight in the fridge. Cutting through the shell lets the butter in.

steps.instruction: Heat the grill to high.
Cut down the back of each shell of {{ing:lobster-tail}} with scissors.
steps.note: Stop at the tail fan.

steps.instruction: Ease the meat up so it sits on top of the shell.
Mash {{ing:butter-block}} with crushed {{ing:garlic-clove}}, chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}} and {{ing:chives}}.
Add the zest of {{ing:lemon}} and a pinch of salt.
Spread half the butter over the meat. Dust with {{ing:smoked-paprika}}.
Grill 8 minutes, until the meat is white all through.
steps.note: About 1 minute per 25 g of tail.

steps.instruction: Melt the rest of the butter. Spoon over to serve, with lemon wedges.

swaps.text: Large raw king prawns, grilled for 3 minutes
Olive oil with the same garlic and herbs, to make it dairy free

recipes.name: Thai green king prawn curry with lime leaves and galangal
recipes.method_note: Galangal and lime leaves are what make it taste like a Thai restaurant. Both freeze well.

steps.instruction: Rinse {{ing:rice-jasmine-dry}}. Cook it the way the packet says.
steps.note: Keep it covered off the heat once cooked.

steps.instruction: Peel and slice {{ing:galangal}} thinly.
Bash {{ing:lemongrass}} with a rolling pin to bruise it.
Put a wok or large pan on a medium heat. Add {{ing:vegetable-oil}}.
Fry {{ing:thai-green-curry-paste}} for 2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}}, the galangal, lemongrass and torn {{ing:lime-leaves}}.
Add {{ing:fish-sauce}} and {{ing:palm-sugar}}. Simmer 5 minutes.
Halve {{ing:green-beans}}. Add and simmer 4 minutes.
Add {{ing:king-prawns-raw}}. Cook 3 minutes, until pink all over.
Take out the lemongrass. Stir in {{ing:fresh-basil}}.
steps.note: Leave the galangal and lime leaves in, but they are not for eating.

steps.instruction: Taste. Add a squeeze of {{ing:lime}}. Serve with the rice.

swaps.text: Chunks of firm tofu, with soy sauce for the fish sauce, for a vegan version (check the paste has no shrimp)
Soft brown sugar
The same weight of fresh ginger

recipes.name: Squash, spinach and goats' cheese Wellington
recipes.method_note: Roast the squash and dry the spinach well, or the pastry base goes soggy.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Peel {{ing:butternut-squash}}. Cut into 2 cm cubes.
Slice {{ing:red-onion}}. Toss both with {{ing:olive-oil}} and chopped {{ing:fresh-sage}}.
Roast 30 minutes, until soft and browning.
Wilt {{ing:spinach}} in a dry pan, 2 minutes.
Squeeze out all the water from the spinach in a clean tea towel.
Cool the squash. Mix with spinach, chopped {{ing:chestnuts-cooked}} and {{ing:dried-cranberries}}.
Crumble in {{ing:goats-cheese}}. Season.
Lay one sheet of {{ing:puff-pastry}} on a lined tray.
Pile the filling down the middle, leaving 3 cm clear all round.
Beat {{ing:egg-medium}}. Brush the clear edge.
Lay the second sheet over. Press the edges to seal. Trim.
Brush all over with egg. Cut three slits in the top.
Bake 35 minutes, until deep golden.
Rest 10 minutes before slicing.

swaps.text: Vegan feta-style cheese, with plant milk to glaze and vegan pastry, for a vegan version
Toasted pumpkin seeds

recipes.name: Cranberry and chestnut nut roast
recipes.method_note: Make it a day ahead and reheat in slices. It cuts more neatly cold.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Line a 900 g loaf tin with baking paper.
Stir {{ing:chia-seeds}} into {{ing:water}}. Leave 10 minutes to thicken.
steps.note: This holds it together, the way egg would.

steps.instruction: Put a frying pan on a medium heat. Add {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Chop {{ing:onion-medium}}, {{ing:carrot-medium}} and {{ing:celery-stick}} finely. Fry 10 minutes.
Chop {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}}. Add with {{ing:dried-mixed-herbs}}. Fry 8 minutes, until dry.
Pulse {{ing:cashews}} and {{ing:pecans}} in a food processor until coarse.
Crumble {{ing:chestnuts-cooked}} into a big bowl. Add the nuts and vegetables.
Add {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}}, {{ing:tahini}}, {{ing:soy-sauce}} and the chia. Mix well.
Spread {{ing:cranberry-sauce}} over the base of the tin.
Press the mixture in firmly. Cover with foil.
Bake 30 minutes. Take off the foil. Bake 15 minutes more.
Rest 15 minutes. Turn out, cranberry side up.

swaps.text: Walnuts or hazelnuts
Gluten-free breadcrumbs and tamari, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Whole roast spiced cauliflower with tahini and pomegranate
recipes.method_note: Steaming first means the middle is tender by the time the outside is golden.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Trim the outer leaves from {{ing:cauliflower-head}}, keeping it whole.
Steam or boil it whole for 8 minutes. Drain well.
Mix {{ing:olive-oil}}, {{ing:ras-el-hanout}}, crushed {{ing:garlic-clove}} and a pinch of salt.
Rub it all over the cauliflower. Sit it in a roasting tin.
Roast 40 minutes, until golden and a knife slides in.
Whisk {{ing:tahini}} with the juice of {{ing:lemon}} and 3 tbsp water.
steps.note: It thickens before it loosens. Keep whisking.

steps.instruction: Drizzle the tahini and {{ing:pomegranate-molasses}} over the cauliflower.
Scatter {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}}, chopped {{ing:pistachios}} and {{ing:fresh-mint}}.

swaps.text: Toasted pumpkin seeds, for a nut-free version
1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika and a pinch of cinnamon

recipes.name: Celeriac steaks with mushroom and green peppercorn sauce
recipes.method_note: Thick slices roasted until golden eat like a steak. The sauce works with beef too.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Peel {{ing:celeriac}}. Cut into four 2 cm slices.
Brush with 2 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}}. Season. Lay {{ing:fresh-thyme}} on top.
Roast 45 minutes, turning once, until golden and tender.
Put a frying pan on a medium heat with the rest of the oil.
Slice {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}}. Chop {{ing:shallot}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}}.
Fry them 10 minutes, until browned and dry.
Drain and crush {{ing:green-peppercorns-brine}}. Add with {{ing:mustard-dijon}}.
Pour in {{ing:oat-cream}}. Simmer 3 minutes, until thick.
Spoon the sauce over the celeriac steaks.

swaps.text: Double cream, for a vegetarian version
Thick slices of cauliflower or portobello mushrooms, roasted 25 minutes

recipes.name: Crisp roast potatoes
recipes.method_note: Roughing up the edges after boiling is what makes them crisp.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 220C. Put {{ing:vegetable-oil}} in a large roasting tin in the oven.
Peel {{ing:potato-large}}. Cut into large chunks.
Boil in salted water 8 minutes, until the edges soften.
Drain. Leave to steam dry 3 minutes.
Shake the pan to rough up the edges.
Carefully tip the potatoes into the hot oil. Turn to coat.
steps.note: The oil should sizzle. If not, heat it longer.

steps.instruction: Roast 30 minutes.
Turn them. Add {{ing:fresh-rosemary}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}} in their skins.
Roast 20 minutes more, until deep golden and crisp.
Sprinkle with {{ing:salt}}.

swaps.text: Duck or goose fat, for the classic flavour (not vegetarian)

recipes.name: Honey-roast parsnips and carrots
recipes.method_note: Add the honey near the end. Added early, it burns.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Peel {{ing:parsnip}} and {{ing:carrot-medium}}. Cut into long batons.
Toss with {{ing:olive-oil}}, {{ing:fresh-thyme}} and a pinch of salt.
Spread in a roasting tin in one layer.
Roast 30 minutes, until starting to brown.
Drizzle {{ing:honey}} over. Toss.
Roast 10 minutes more, until sticky.

swaps.text: Maple syrup, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Sprouts with chestnuts and bacon
recipes.method_note: Halving the sprouts and frying them gives sweet, browned edges.

steps.instruction: Trim and halve {{ing:brussels-sprouts}}.
Boil 3 minutes. Drain well.
Put a large frying pan on a medium heat.
Snip {{ing:bacon-streaky-raw}} into pieces. Fry 5 minutes, until crisp.
Add {{ing:butter-block}} and the sprouts. Fry 5 minutes, until browned.
Crumble in {{ing:chestnuts-cooked}}. Stir 2 minutes to warm.
Grate over {{ing:nutmeg}}. Add a squeeze of {{ing:lemon}}.

swaps.text: Smoked paprika and a little more butter, for a vegetarian version
Olive oil, to make it dairy free

recipes.name: Braised red cabbage with apple and spice
recipes.method_note: Make it up to three days ahead. It tastes better reheated.

steps.instruction: Put a large pan on a medium heat. Add {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Slice {{ing:red-onion}}. Fry 5 minutes, until soft.
Shred {{ing:red-cabbage}} finely, without the core.
Grate {{ing:apple-medium}}, skin and all, round the core.
Add both with {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}}, {{ing:balsamic-vinegar}} and {{ing:wine-red}}.
Add {{ing:cinnamon-stick}}, {{ing:cloves}} and a pinch of salt.
Cover. Cook on a low heat 1 hour, stirring now and then.
Take out the cinnamon and cloves. Taste for salt.

swaps.text: Apple juice, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Cranberry and orange sauce
recipes.method_note: It thickens a lot as it cools. Keeps in the fridge for a week.

steps.instruction: Put {{ing:cranberries}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}} in a pan.
Add the zest and juice of {{ing:orange}}, {{ing:port}} and {{ing:cinnamon-stick}}.
Heat gently, stirring, until the sugar dissolves.
Simmer 8 minutes, until most cranberries have burst.
Take out the cinnamon. Cool.

swaps.text: More orange juice, for no alcohol, or if your port is not labelled vegan

recipes.name: Bread sauce
recipes.method_note: Infuse the milk an hour or more ahead if you can. The flavour comes from the wait.

steps.instruction: Cut {{ing:onion-medium}} in half. Push {{ing:cloves}} into it.
Put it in a pan with {{ing:milk-whole}}, {{ing:bay-leaf}} and {{ing:black-peppercorns}}.
Bring almost to the boil. Take off the heat.
Leave to infuse for at least 30 minutes.
Cut the crusts off {{ing:bread-slice-medium}}. Whizz into crumbs.
Strain the milk. Return it to the pan.
Stir in the crumbs. Simmer 3 minutes, until thick.
Stir in {{ing:butter-block}}, {{ing:double-cream}} and {{ing:nutmeg}}. Season.

swaps.text: Unsweetened oat milk, with olive oil for the butter, for a vegan version
Gluten-free bread, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Pigs in blankets
recipes.method_note: Stretching the bacon with the back of a knife makes it go further and wrap tighter.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Line a tray with baking paper.
Stretch each rasher of {{ing:bacon-streaky-raw}} with the back of a knife. Cut in half.
Wrap a piece of bacon round each of {{ing:chipolatas}}.
Lay them seam down on the tray.
Roast 25 minutes.
Mix {{ing:honey}} and {{ing:wholegrain-mustard}}. Brush over.
Roast 5 minutes more, until sticky and cooked through.

swaps.text: Gluten-free sausages, for a gluten-free version
Vegetarian sausages wrapped in thin strips of courgette

recipes.name: Turkey gravy from the roasting tin
recipes.method_note: The browned bits in the tin are the flavour. Scrape them all up.

steps.instruction: Pour the juices from the turkey tin into a jug. Let the fat rise.
Spoon 2 tbsp of the fat back into the tin. Keep the juices.
Put the tin on the hob on a medium heat.
Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Cook 1 minute.
Add {{ing:wine-red}}. Scrape up every browned bit.
Whisk in {{ing:stock-chicken}} and the juices from under the fat.
Simmer 8 minutes, until it coats a spoon.
Stir in {{ing:redcurrant-jelly}}. Season. Strain into a warm jug.

swaps.text: Cornflour mixed with a little cold water, for a gluten-free version
More stock, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Rich onion and mushroom gravy
recipes.method_note: Take the onions to dark brown, slowly. That is where the depth comes from.

steps.instruction: Put a pan on a medium-low heat. Add {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Slice {{ing:onion-medium}}. Cook 20 minutes, stirring, until dark brown.
Chop {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}}. Add with {{ing:dried-thyme}}. Cook 8 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Cook 1 minute.
Add {{ing:wine-red}}. Bubble 2 minutes.
Whisk in {{ing:stock-vegetable}} and {{ing:soy-sauce}}.
Simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:cranberry-sauce}}. Blend smooth, or strain.
Season and serve hot.

swaps.text: More stock with 1 tsp balsamic vinegar, for no alcohol (check the wine is labelled vegan)
Cornflour and tamari, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Brandy butter
recipes.method_note: Keeps in the fridge for two weeks. Take it out 30 minutes before serving.

steps.instruction: Beat {{ing:butter-unsalted}} in a bowl until soft and pale.
Sift in {{ing:icing-sugar}}. Beat until fluffy.
Beat in {{ing:spirit-40}} (brandy), a spoonful at a time.
steps.note: Added too fast, it can split.

steps.instruction: Grate in the zest of {{ing:orange}}. Chill until needed.

swaps.text: Orange juice, for no alcohol
Dairy-free block, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Christmas pudding
recipes.method_note: Make it weeks ahead and keep it somewhere cool. It deepens with time.

steps.instruction: Put {{ing:currants}}, {{ing:sultanas}}, {{ing:raisins}} and {{ing:mixed-peel}} in a big bowl.
Add {{ing:spirit-40}} (brandy) and the zest and juice of {{ing:orange}}.
Cover. Leave overnight to soak.
Grease a 1.2 litre pudding basin well.
Grate {{ing:apple-medium}} into the fruit.
Add {{ing:suet-vegetable}}, {{ing:flour-self-raising}}, {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}} and {{ing:sugar-muscovado}}.
Add {{ing:ground-almonds}} and {{ing:mixed-spice}}.
Beat {{ing:egg-medium}} with {{ing:black-treacle}}. Stir everything together well.
Spoon into the basin. Press down.
Cover with pleated baking paper and foil. Tie on with string.
steps.note: The pleat lets it rise.

steps.instruction: Sit it on a saucer in a large pan. Pour boiling water halfway up.
Cover. Simmer 6 hours, topping up with boiling water.
steps.note: Check every hour. The pan must not boil dry.

steps.instruction: Cool. Replace the paper and foil. Store somewhere cool and dark.
On the day, steam 2 hours to reheat.

swaps.text: Cold butter, grated, for a richer pudding (no longer dairy free)
Cold black tea, for no alcohol
Gluten-free flour and gluten-free breadcrumbs, for a gluten-free version
More breadcrumbs, for a nut-free version

recipes.name: Mince pies
recipes.method_note: Keep everything cold for the crispest pastry.

steps.instruction: Rub {{ing:butter-block}} into {{ing:flour-plain}} until it looks like crumbs.
Stir in 20 g of {{ing:icing-sugar}} and the zest of {{ing:orange}}.
Beat {{ing:egg-medium}}. Add half. Bring together into a dough.
steps.note: Add a few drops of cold water if it is dry.

steps.instruction: Wrap. Chill 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Roll the pastry thinly. Cut 12 rounds of 8 cm.
Press them into a 12-hole bun tin.
Spoon in {{ing:mincemeat}}, a heaped teaspoon each.
Re-roll the trimmings. Cut 12 small stars for the tops.
Brush the stars with the rest of the egg.
Bake 15 minutes, until golden.
Cool 5 minutes in the tin. Dust with the rest of the icing sugar.

swaps.text: Dairy-free block and vegetarian mincemeat, with plant milk to glaze, for a vegan version
Gluten-free plain flour with 1/4 tsp xanthan gum, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Sherry trifle
recipes.method_note: Assemble the morning of the day, so the sponge soaks through.

steps.instruction: Break {{ing:sponge-fingers}} into a glass bowl.
Spoon {{ing:sherry}} over evenly.
Scatter {{ing:raspberries}} on top. Press down lightly.
steps.note: Frozen raspberries are fine; their juice helps the soak.

steps.instruction: Pour {{ing:custard-ready}} over in an even layer.
Chill 1 hour, until set.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}} with {{ing:icing-sugar}} and {{ing:vanilla-extract}} to soft peaks.
Spread over the custard.
Toast {{ing:ground-almonds}} (flaked) in a dry pan. Scatter on top.

swaps.text: Orange juice, for no alcohol
Grated dark chocolate, for a nut-free version

recipes.name: Chocolate yule log
recipes.method_note: Roll the sponge while it is warm, then it will roll again later without cracking.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Line a 23 x 33 cm Swiss roll tin.
Whisk {{ing:egg-medium}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}} for 5 minutes, until thick and pale.
steps.note: The mixture should leave a trail when the whisk is lifted.

steps.instruction: Sift in {{ing:flour-self-raising}} and 25 g of {{ing:cocoa-powder}}.
Fold in gently with a large spoon.
Spread into the tin. Bake 9 minutes, until springy.
Turn onto baking paper dusted with sugar. Peel off the lining.
Roll up from a short end, with the paper inside. Cool.
Melt {{ing:dark-chocolate}} with {{ing:butter-block}} and 100 ml of the cream.
Sift in {{ing:icing-sugar}} and the rest of the cocoa. Stir. Cool until spreadable.
Whip the rest of {{ing:double-cream}} to soft peaks.
Unroll the sponge. Spread with cream. Roll it up again.
Cover with the icing. Drag a fork along to look like bark.

swaps.text: Gluten-free self-raising flour, for a gluten-free version
Whipping cream

recipes.name: Pavlova with clementines and pomegranate
recipes.method_note: Leave the meringue to cool in the switched-off oven, so it does not crack.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 140C. Draw a 22 cm circle on baking paper on a tray.
Whisk {{ing:egg-white}} in a clean bowl until stiff.
steps.note: Any trace of yolk or grease stops them whisking.

steps.instruction: Add {{ing:sugar-caster}} a spoonful at a time, whisking, until glossy.
Whisk in {{ing:cornflour}} and {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}}.
Spread inside the circle, higher at the edges.
Turn the oven to 120C. Bake 1 hour 15 minutes.
Switch off the oven. Leave inside to cool completely.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}} with {{ing:vanilla-extract}} to soft peaks.
Peel {{ing:clementine}}. Slice into rounds.
Pile the cream on the meringue. Add the clementines.
Scatter {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}}, chopped {{ing:pistachios}} and {{ing:fresh-mint}}.

swaps.text: Thick coconut yoghurt, for a dairy-free version
Leave them out, for a nut-free version

recipes.name: Sticky toffee pudding
recipes.method_note: Pour some sauce over the hot sponge and let it soak in before serving.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Grease a 20 cm square tin.
Chop {{ing:dates-pitted}}. Put in a pan with {{ing:water}}.
Boil 5 minutes. Stir in {{ing:bicarbonate-of-soda}}. Leave to cool.
steps.note: It froths up. That is meant to happen.

steps.instruction: Beat 75 g of {{ing:butter-block}} with 150 g of {{ing:sugar-muscovado}}.
Beat in {{ing:egg-medium}}, one at a time.
Fold in {{ing:flour-self-raising}}, {{ing:vanilla-extract}} and the dates.
Pour into the tin. Bake 30 minutes, until springy.
Melt the rest of the butter and sugar in a pan.
Add {{ing:black-treacle}} and {{ing:double-cream}}.
Simmer 3 minutes, until glossy.
Spike the warm sponge with a skewer. Pour over a third of the sauce.
Serve in squares with the rest of the sauce.

swaps.text: Dairy-free block and oat cream, for a dairy-free version
Gluten-free self-raising flour, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Chocolate orange mousse
recipes.method_note: Silken tofu makes it smooth and rich, and nobody will guess.

steps.instruction: Melt {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}} in a bowl over a pan of simmering water.
steps.note: Do not let the bowl touch the water.

steps.instruction: Cool 5 minutes.
Drain {{ing:tofu-silken}}. Blend until completely smooth.
Add the chocolate, {{ing:maple-syrup}} and {{ing:vanilla-extract}}. Blend again.
Grate in the zest of {{ing:orange}}. Add {{ing:orange-liqueur}}. Blend briefly.
Spoon into 6 small glasses.
Chill at least 2 hours, until set.
Top with thin strips of orange zest.

swaps.text: Orange juice, for no alcohol
Check the label says vegan if you need it to be

recipes.name: Pears poached in mulled wine
recipes.method_note: Make them a day ahead. They turn a deeper red sitting in the syrup overnight.

steps.instruction: Put {{ing:wine-red}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}} in a pan the pears will fit in snugly.
Add strips of zest from {{ing:orange}}, {{ing:cinnamon-stick}}, {{ing:star-anise}} and {{ing:cloves}}.
Heat, stirring, until the sugar dissolves.
Peel {{ing:pear}}, keeping the stalks on. Trim the bases so they stand.
Lay them in the wine. Cover with a circle of baking paper.
Simmer 25 minutes, turning now and then, until tender.
Lift out the pears. Boil the wine 10 minutes, until syrupy.
Serve the pears with the syrup poured over.

swaps.text: Red grape juice with less sugar (50 g), for no alcohol (check the wine is labelled vegan)

recipes.name: Panettone bread and butter pudding
recipes.method_note: Soaking for 20 minutes before baking gives a soft middle and crisp top.

steps.instruction: Grease a 1.5 litre baking dish with a little of {{ing:butter-block}}.
Slice {{ing:panettone}} thickly. Butter one side of each slice.
Cut into triangles. Arrange in the dish, overlapping.
Whisk {{ing:egg-medium}}, {{ing:milk-whole}}, {{ing:double-cream}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}} and {{ing:vanilla-extract}}.
Pour over the panettone. Leave 20 minutes to soak.
Heat the oven to 180C.
Sprinkle with {{ing:sugar-demerara}}.
Bake 35 minutes, until set and golden.
steps.note: It should wobble a little in the middle.

swaps.text: Brioche or leftover white bread with a handful of sultanas

recipes.name: Coconut, lime and lemongrass rice pudding
recipes.method_note: Thai-style and dairy free. Good warm or chilled.

steps.instruction: Put {{ing:rice-jasmine-dry}}, {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}}, {{ing:oat-milk}} and {{ing:palm-sugar}} in a pan.
Bruise {{ing:lemongrass}} with a rolling pin. Add with {{ing:lime-leaves}}.
Bring to a simmer, stirring.
Cook on a low heat 30 minutes, stirring often, until thick.
steps.note: Add a splash of oat milk if it gets too thick.

steps.instruction: Take out the lemongrass and lime leaves.
Grate in the zest of {{ing:lime}}.
Peel and dice {{ing:mango}}. Spoon over to serve.

swaps.text: Pineapple, or passion fruit
Soft brown sugar

recipes.name: Mulled wine
recipes.method_note: Keep it hot, never boiling. Boiling drives off the alcohol and turns the spices bitter.

steps.instruction: Pour {{ing:wine-red}} into a large pan.
Slice {{ing:orange}}. Add with {{ing:sugar-demerara}}.
Add {{ing:cinnamon-stick}}, {{ing:cloves}}, {{ing:star-anise}} and {{ing:nutmeg}}.
Warm on a low heat, stirring, until the sugar dissolves.
Keep it steaming gently for 15 minutes.
steps.note: Small wisps of steam, no bubbles.

steps.instruction: Stir in {{ing:spirit-40}} (brandy). Ladle into heatproof glasses.

swaps.text: Leave it out, for a lighter drink
Check the label says vegan if you need it to be

recipes.name: Mulled cider
recipes.method_note: Apple and ginger keep it bright. Lovely with gammon.

steps.instruction: Pour {{ing:cider-dry}} into a large pan.
Slice {{ing:apple-medium}}, {{ing:orange}} and {{ing:ginger-fresh}}. Add them.
Add {{ing:cinnamon-stick}}, {{ing:cloves}} and {{ing:star-anise}}.
Warm on a low heat for 15 minutes, without boiling.
Sweeten with {{ing:maple-syrup}} to taste. Ladle into glasses.

swaps.text: Cloudy apple juice, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Cranberry and orange fizz
recipes.method_note: Chill everything well first. Pour the fizz last so it stays lively.

steps.instruction: Put 3 or 4 frozen {{ing:cranberries}} in each glass.
Add 50 ml of {{ing:cranberry-juice}} and 10 ml of {{ing:orange-liqueur}} to each.
Top up slowly with {{ing:sparkling-wine}}.
Twist a strip of zest from {{ing:orange}} over each glass. Drop it in.

swaps.text: Sparkling water or sparkling apple juice, with no liqueur, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Clementine and rosemary gin and tonic
recipes.method_note: Bruising the rosemary releases its scent into the glass.

steps.instruction: Fill four glasses with ice.
Squeeze the juice of half of {{ing:clementine}} into each.
Bruise {{ing:fresh-rosemary}} between your hands. Add a sprig to each.
Pour 50 ml of {{ing:spirit-40}} (gin) into each glass.
Top up with {{ing:tonic-water}}. Stir once.

swaps.text: Leave it out and add a splash of cranberry juice, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Cooked eggnog
recipes.method_note: Cooked gently to 71C, so the eggs are safe for everyone.

steps.instruction: Whisk {{ing:egg-yolk}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}} in a bowl until pale.
Warm {{ing:milk-whole}} and {{ing:double-cream}} in a pan until steaming.
Pour a little onto the yolks, whisking. Then pour it all back into the pan.
Stir on a low heat 6 minutes, until it coats a spoon.
steps.note: 71C on a thermometer. Do not let it boil, or it scrambles.

steps.instruction: Take off the heat. Stir in {{ing:vanilla-extract}} and half of {{ing:nutmeg}}.
Cool, then chill 2 hours.
Stir in {{ing:spirit-40}} (rum or brandy). Serve with the rest of the nutmeg.

swaps.text: Leave it out, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Hot spiced apple and cranberry punch
recipes.method_note: Everything you love about mulled wine, with no alcohol. Children love it.

steps.instruction: Pour {{ing:apple-juice}} and {{ing:cranberry-juice}} into a large pan.
Slice {{ing:orange}} and {{ing:ginger-fresh}}. Add them.
Add {{ing:cinnamon-stick}}, {{ing:cloves}} and {{ing:star-anise}}.
Warm on a low heat for 15 minutes, without boiling.
Ladle into mugs, leaving the spices behind.

recipes.name: Mulled red grape juice
recipes.method_note: A soft drink with the weight of red wine, for the main course.

steps.instruction: Pour {{ing:grape-juice-red}} into a pan.
Slice {{ing:orange}} and {{ing:ginger-fresh}}. Add them.
Add {{ing:cinnamon-stick}}, {{ing:cloves}} and {{ing:star-anise}}.
Warm on a low heat for 10 minutes, without boiling.
Strain into glasses. Serve warm.

recipes.name: Orange hot chocolate
recipes.method_note: Real chocolate, melted in, makes it rich enough to be pudding.

steps.instruction: Warm {{ing:milk-whole}} in a pan with strips of zest from {{ing:orange}}.
Bring almost to the boil. Take off the heat. Leave 5 minutes.
Lift out the zest. Break in {{ing:dark-chocolate}}. Whisk until melted.
Whisk in {{ing:maple-syrup}} and {{ing:cinnamon-ground}}.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}} lightly. Spoon onto each mug.

swaps.text: Oat milk and oat cream with vegan chocolate, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Pomegranate and ginger fizz
recipes.method_note: Sharp, spicy and festive red. No alcohol.

steps.instruction: Fill four glasses with ice.
Pour 75 ml of {{ing:pomegranate-juice}} into each.
Squeeze in a wedge of {{ing:lime}}.
Top up with {{ing:ginger-beer}}.
Spoon in {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}}. Add a sprig of {{ing:fresh-mint}}.

recipes.name: Elderflower and cranberry spritz
recipes.method_note: Light and floral: good with fish and starters. No alcohol.

steps.instruction: Put a few frozen {{ing:cranberries}} and ice in each glass.
Add 15 ml of {{ing:elderflower-cordial}} and 50 ml of {{ing:cranberry-juice}} to each.
Top up with {{ing:sparkling-water}}.
Add a thin slice of {{ing:lime}}.

recipes.name: Ginger, lime and lemongrass cooler
recipes.method_note: A Thai-style syrup that keeps a week in the fridge. Made for spicy food.

steps.instruction: Slice {{ing:ginger-fresh}}. Bash {{ing:lemongrass}} with a rolling pin. Chop it.
Put them in a pan with {{ing:lime-leaves}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}} and {{ing:water}}.
Simmer 5 minutes. Cool. Strain.
Squeeze the juice of {{ing:lime}} into the syrup.
Divide between four glasses of ice. Top up with {{ing:sparkling-water}}.

recipes.name: Beetroot and gin cured salmon
recipes.method_note: Start two days ahead. The cure does the cooking; you only slice.

steps.instruction: Check {{ing:salmon-fillet}} for pin bones. Pull any out with tweezers.
Grate raw {{ing:beetroot}}. Mix with {{ing:sugar-caster}}, {{ing:salt}} and the zest of {{ing:lemon}}.
steps.note: Wear gloves: beetroot stains.

steps.instruction: Stir in {{ing:spirit-40}} (gin) and half of {{ing:fresh-dill}}.
Lay the salmon skin down on cling film. Pack the cure over the top.
Wrap tightly. Put in a dish with a weight on top.
Chill 48 hours, turning once a day.
Scrape off the cure. Rinse briefly. Pat dry.
Press the rest of the dill on top. Slice thinly at an angle.
Serve with {{ing:rocket}} and lemon wedges.

swaps.text: Leave it out, for no alcohol; the cure still works
Trout fillet, cured for 36 hours

recipes.name: Baked camembert with garlic and rosemary
recipes.method_note: Use a camembert in a wooden box: it bakes in it.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Unwrap {{ing:camembert}}. Put it back in its box. Sit the box on a tray.
Cut small slits in the top.
Slice {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Push slivers and sprigs of {{ing:fresh-rosemary}} into the slits.
Drizzle with {{ing:honey}}. Bake 15 minutes, until soft in the middle.
Toast {{ing:sourdough}} to dip.
Serve straight away with the toast and {{ing:cranberry-sauce}}.

swaps.text: Gluten-free crackers or crudités, for a gluten-free version
A small whole brie

recipes.name: Potted prawns with mace and lemon
recipes.method_note: Make it a day ahead. The butter sets and seals it.

steps.instruction: Melt {{ing:butter-block}} in a small pan on a low heat.
Stir in {{ing:mace}}, {{ing:cayenne-pepper}} and the zest of {{ing:lemon}}.
Chop {{ing:prawns-cooked}} roughly. Stir into the butter with a squeeze of lemon.
Stir in chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}}. Season.
Spoon into six small pots. Press down so the butter covers the top.
Chill at least 3 hours, until set.
Take out 20 minutes before eating. Serve with {{ing:oatcakes}}.

swaps.text: Oatcakes labelled gluten free, or toast for a non gluten-free version
Brown shrimp, the traditional choice

recipes.name: Smoked mackerel pâté
recipes.method_note: Ready in 10 minutes and keeps three days in the fridge.

steps.instruction: Peel the skin off {{ing:smoked-mackerel}}. Flake the flesh into a bowl.
Add {{ing:cream-cheese}}, {{ing:creme-fraiche}} and {{ing:horseradish-sauce}}.
Mash with a fork until mostly smooth, with some flakes left.
Add the zest and half the juice of {{ing:lemon}}. Season with pepper.
Stir in chopped {{ing:chives}}. Spoon into a dish.
Serve with {{ing:oatcakes}} and lemon wedges.

swaps.text: Thick Greek yoghurt, for a lighter pâté
Hot-smoked salmon or trout

recipes.name: Crab, chilli and avocado toasts
recipes.method_note: Toast the bread well so it stays crisp under the crab.

steps.instruction: Brush {{ing:sourdough}} with {{ing:olive-oil}}. Toast until golden and crisp.
Mash {{ing:avocado}} with half the juice of {{ing:lime}} and a pinch of salt.
Mix {{ing:crab-white-meat}} with {{ing:mayonnaise}} and the zest of the lime.
Chop {{ing:chilli-fresh}} finely, without the seeds if you prefer it mild.
Spread the avocado on the toasts. Pile the crab on top.
Scatter the chilli and {{ing:fresh-coriander}}. Squeeze over the rest of the lime.

swaps.text: Cooked prawns, chopped
Gluten-free bread, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Whipped feta with honey, pomegranate and pistachios
recipes.method_note: Whipped feta keeps in the fridge for two days. Serve with flatbread or crudités.

steps.instruction: Crumble {{ing:feta}} into a food processor.
Add {{ing:greek-yoghurt}} and the zest of {{ing:lemon}}. Blend until smooth and fluffy.
Spread onto a plate in a swirl with the back of a spoon.
Drizzle with {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:honey}}.
Scatter {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}}, chopped {{ing:pistachios}} and {{ing:fresh-mint}}.
Cut {{ing:carrot-medium}} into sticks to scoop with.

swaps.text: Maple syrup
Toasted pumpkin seeds, for a nut-free version

recipes.name: Roast butternut squash and sage soup
recipes.method_note: Roasting the squash first gives a deeper, sweeter soup than boiling.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Peel and chunk {{ing:butternut-squash}}. Cut {{ing:onion-medium}} into wedges.
Toss with {{ing:garlic-clove}}, 2 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}} and half of {{ing:fresh-sage}}.
Roast 35 minutes, until soft and browning at the edges.
Squeeze the garlic out of its skins. Tip everything into a pan.
Add {{ing:stock-vegetable}} and {{ing:nutmeg}}. Simmer 5 minutes.
Blend until smooth. Season.
Fry the rest of the sage in the rest of the oil until crisp.
Serve topped with crispy sage and toasted {{ing:pumpkin-seeds}}.

swaps.text: A swirl of cream, for a non-vegan version

recipes.name: Celeriac and apple soup with hazelnuts
recipes.method_note: Celeriac gives a velvety soup with a gentle celery flavour.

steps.instruction: Put a large pan on a medium heat. Add {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Slice {{ing:leek}}. Fry 8 minutes, until soft.
Peel and chop {{ing:celeriac}} and {{ing:apple-medium}}. Add with {{ing:fresh-thyme}}.
Pour in {{ing:stock-vegetable}}. Simmer 25 minutes, until the celeriac is soft.
Take out the thyme stalks. Blend until smooth.
Stir in {{ing:oat-cream}}. Season.
Toast and chop {{ing:hazelnuts}}. Scatter over to serve.

swaps.text: Crisp sage leaves, for a nut-free version

recipes.name: Leek, potato and Stilton soup
recipes.method_note: A good home for the Stilton left after Christmas Day.

steps.instruction: Melt {{ing:butter-block}} in a large pan on a medium heat.
Slice {{ing:leek}}. Cook 10 minutes, until soft but not brown.
Peel and dice {{ing:potato-large}}. Add with {{ing:stock-vegetable}}.
Simmer 20 minutes, until the potato is soft.
Blend until smooth.
Crumble in most of {{ing:stilton}}. Stir until melted.
Stir in {{ing:single-cream}}. Season with pepper.
steps.note: Taste before adding salt: Stilton is salty.

steps.instruction: Serve with the rest of the Stilton and {{ing:chives}} on top.

swaps.text: Mature cheddar
Check the label says gluten free, if you need it

recipes.name: Fig, ricotta and honey crostini
recipes.method_note: Assemble at the last minute so the toasts stay crisp.

steps.instruction: Heat the grill. Cut {{ing:sourdough}} in half. Brush with {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Grill 2 minutes a side, until golden.
Beat {{ing:ricotta}} with the zest of {{ing:lemon}} and a pinch of salt.
Cut {{ing:figs-fresh}} into wedges.
Spread ricotta on each toast. Top with figs.
Drizzle with {{ing:honey}}. Scatter chopped {{ing:walnuts}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}} leaves.

swaps.text: Thin slices of pear, out of fig season
Soft goats' cheese

recipes.name: Garlic mushrooms on toasted sourdough
recipes.method_note: A hot pan and space in it browns the mushrooms instead of stewing them.

steps.instruction: Soak {{ing:shiitake-dried}} in 100 ml boiling water for 15 minutes. Chop.
Put a large frying pan on a high heat. Add 2 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Slice {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}}. Fry 6 minutes, until golden.
Add the soaked mushrooms, sliced {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}. Fry 2 minutes.
Add {{ing:sherry}} and 2 tbsp of the soaking water. Bubble until glossy.
Stir in chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}}. Season.
Toast {{ing:sourdough}}. Brush with the rest of the oil.
Pile the mushrooms on top.

swaps.text: A squeeze of lemon, for no alcohol
Gluten-free bread, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Griddled halloumi with pomegranate and mint
recipes.method_note: Cook halloumi just before eating: it turns rubbery as it cools.

steps.instruction: Slice {{ing:halloumi}} into 8 pieces. Pat dry.
Put a griddle or frying pan on a high heat. Brush with {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Cook the halloumi 2 minutes a side, until striped golden.
Whisk the juice of {{ing:lemon}} with {{ing:pomegranate-molasses}}.
Lay {{ing:rocket}} on plates. Top with the halloumi.
Spoon over the dressing. Scatter {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}} and torn {{ing:fresh-mint}}.

swaps.text: Thick slices of firm tofu, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Hot and sour prawn soup with lemongrass and lime leaf
recipes.method_note: A light, bright start before a rich main. Galangal, lime leaf and lemongrass are for flavour, not for eating.

steps.instruction: Pour {{ing:stock-chicken}} into a pan. Bring to a simmer.
Bash {{ing:lemongrass}} and cut into lengths. Slice {{ing:galangal}}.
Add them with torn {{ing:lime-leaves}} and halved {{ing:chilli-fresh}}. Simmer 10 minutes.
Slice {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}}. Add and simmer 3 minutes.
Add {{ing:king-prawns-raw}}. Cook 3 minutes, until pink.
Take off the heat. Stir in {{ing:fish-sauce}} and the juice of {{ing:lime}}.
Taste: it should be sour, salty and hot. Adjust with lime or fish sauce.
Serve with {{ing:fresh-coriander}} on top.

swaps.text: Vegetable stock, with tofu for the prawns and soy sauce for fish sauce, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Chicory, pear and blue cheese salad
recipes.method_note: Bitter chicory, sweet pear and salty cheese: the classic winter salad.

steps.instruction: Separate the leaves of {{ing:chicory}}. Arrange on plates.
Core and slice {{ing:pear}} thinly. Tuck among the leaves.
Crumble {{ing:stilton}} over. Scatter toasted {{ing:walnuts}}.
Whisk {{ing:olive-oil}}, {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}}, {{ing:honey}} and {{ing:wholegrain-mustard}}.
Drizzle over to serve.

swaps.text: Vegan blue-style cheese and maple syrup for honey, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Sizzling garlic and chilli king prawns
recipes.method_note: Spanish-style. Serve in the pan with bread for the oil.

steps.instruction: Put {{ing:olive-oil}} in a wide pan on a medium-low heat.
Slice {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:chilli-fresh}}. Cook 2 minutes, until the garlic is pale gold.
steps.note: Brown garlic tastes bitter. Keep the heat gentle.

steps.instruction: Turn up the heat. Add {{ing:king-prawns-raw}} and {{ing:smoked-paprika}}.
Cook 3 minutes, turning, until pink.
Add {{ing:sherry}} and a squeeze of {{ing:lemon}}. Bubble 30 seconds.
Scatter chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}}. Serve with {{ing:sourdough}} for the oil.

swaps.text: A splash of water, for no alcohol
Gluten-free bread, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Mussels in white wine and cream
recipes.method_note: Cooked mussel meat warms through in 3 minutes, so the sauce comes first.

steps.instruction: Melt {{ing:butter-block}} in a wide pan on a medium heat.
Chop {{ing:shallot}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Cook 4 minutes, until soft.
Add {{ing:wine-white}}. Boil 2 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:double-cream}}. Simmer 2 minutes.
Add {{ing:mussels-cooked}}. Heat 3 minutes, until hot through.
Stir in chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}}. Season with pepper.
Serve in bowls with {{ing:sourdough}} for the sauce.

swaps.text: Leave it out and add a little more butter, for a lighter broth
1 kg live mussels, cleaned, steamed in the wine for 4 minutes until open; throw away any that stay shut

recipes.name: Spiced red lentil and carrot soup
recipes.method_note: Store-cupboard soup that freezes well. Good on Boxing Day.

steps.instruction: Put a large pan on a medium heat. Add {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Chop {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:carrot-medium}}. Fry 8 minutes, until softening.
Grate in {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:ginger-fresh}}. Add {{ing:cumin-ground}}. Stir 1 minute.
Rinse {{ing:lentils-red-dry}}. Add with {{ing:stock-vegetable}}.
Simmer 20 minutes, until the lentils have collapsed.
Blend until smooth. Squeeze in half of {{ing:lemon}}. Season.

swaps.text: Check the label says gluten free, if you need it

recipes.name: Sweet potato, coconut and lime leaf soup
recipes.method_note: Thai flavours, mild heat. Add more chilli if you like it hot.

steps.instruction: Put a large pan on a medium heat. Add {{ing:vegetable-oil}}.
Chop {{ing:onion-medium}}. Fry 6 minutes, until soft.
Add {{ing:thai-red-curry-paste}}. Stir 1 minute.
steps.note: Check the paste has no shrimp if it must be vegan.

steps.instruction: Peel and chunk {{ing:sweet-potato}}. Add with {{ing:lime-leaves}}.
Pour in {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}} and {{ing:stock-vegetable}}. Simmer 20 minutes.
Take out the lime leaves. Blend until smooth.
Add the juice of {{ing:lime}}. Season. Serve with {{ing:fresh-coriander}}.

swaps.text: Butternut squash

recipes.name: Chestnut and mushroom soup
recipes.method_note: Deep, savoury and rich. A spoonful of sherry at the end lifts it.

steps.instruction: Put a large pan on a medium heat. Add {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Chop {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:celery-stick}}. Fry 8 minutes.
Slice {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}}. Add with {{ing:fresh-thyme}}. Fry 8 minutes, until browned.
Crumble in {{ing:chestnuts-cooked}}. Add {{ing:stock-vegetable}}.
Simmer 15 minutes.
Take out the thyme stalks. Blend until smooth.
Stir in {{ing:sherry}} and {{ing:oat-cream}}. Season.

swaps.text: Leave it out, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Mushroom and chestnut Wellington
recipes.method_note: Most ready-rolled puff pastry is vegan; check the label. Cook the mushrooms until completely dry.

steps.instruction: Put a large frying pan on a medium heat. Add 2 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Chop {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Fry 6 minutes.
Chop {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}} finely. Add with {{ing:fresh-thyme}} leaves.
Fry 15 minutes, until all the liquid has gone.
steps.note: Keep going past when you think it is done.

steps.instruction: Add {{ing:sherry}} and {{ing:soy-sauce}}. Cook until dry again.
Crumble in {{ing:chestnuts-cooked}}. Stir in {{ing:dried-cranberries}}. Cool.
Fry whole {{ing:portobello-mushroom}} in the rest of the oil, 3 minutes a side.
Wilt {{ing:spinach}} in a dry pan. Squeeze out all the water.
Heat the oven to 200C. Lay one sheet of {{ing:puff-pastry}} on a lined tray.
Spread half the chestnut mix down the middle, 3 cm from the edges.
Lay the spinach and portobellos on top. Cover with the rest of the mix.
Brush the edge with {{ing:soya-milk}}. Lay the second sheet over. Press to seal.
Brush all over with soya milk. Score a pattern. Cut two slits.
Bake 35 minutes, until deep golden.
Rest 10 minutes before slicing.

swaps.text: More soy sauce and a splash of water, for no alcohol
Cooked green lentils, drained

recipes.name: Classic nut loaf with cheddar and herbs
recipes.method_note: A traditional nut loaf, bound with egg and cheese. Slices well hot or cold.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Line a 900 g loaf tin with baking paper.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}} in a frying pan on a medium heat.
Chop {{ing:onion-medium}}, {{ing:celery-stick}}, {{ing:carrot-medium}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}} finely. Fry 10 minutes.
Pulse {{ing:cashews}}, {{ing:walnuts}} and {{ing:hazelnuts}} until coarsely chopped.
Mix the nuts, vegetables, {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}} and grated {{ing:cheddar-cheese}} in a bowl.
Beat {{ing:egg-medium}} with {{ing:stock-vegetable}}, {{ing:tomato-purée}} and {{ing:dried-mixed-herbs}}.
Stir into the nut mix. Season well.
Press into the tin. Cover with foil.
Bake 30 minutes. Uncover. Bake 15 minutes more, until firm and browned.
Rest 10 minutes. Turn out and slice.

swaps.text: See the cranberry and chestnut nut roast for a vegan loaf
Gluten-free breadcrumbs, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Chermoula sea bass with herby couscous
recipes.method_note: Chermoula is a North African herb and spice paste. Make it an hour ahead to let the flavours settle.

steps.instruction: Put {{ing:fresh-coriander}}, {{ing:fresh-parsley}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}} in a blender.
Add {{ing:cumin-ground}}, {{ing:smoked-paprika}} and {{ing:chilli-powder}}.
Add the zest and juice of one {{ing:lemon}} and 4 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}}. Blend to a loose paste.
Spread a third of the chermoula over the flesh of {{ing:sea-bass-fillet}}.
Put {{ing:couscous-dry}} in a bowl. Pour over hot {{ing:stock-vegetable}}. Cover 5 minutes.
Fluff with a fork. Stir in a third of the chermoula and {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}}.
Heat the rest of the oil in a frying pan on a medium-high heat.
Fry the fish skin down 3 minutes, pressing flat, until the skin is crisp.
Turn over. Cook 1 minute more.
Serve on the couscous with the rest of the chermoula and lemon wedges.

swaps.text: Quinoa or rice, for a gluten-free version
Bream, cod or salmon fillets

recipes.name: Hasselback butternut squash with sage butter and feta
recipes.method_note: Thin cuts let the butter run into every slice. A showpiece for the vegetarians at the table.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Peel {{ing:butternut-squash}}. Halve lengthways. Scoop out the seeds.
Lay the halves flat side down. Steam or microwave 8 minutes to soften.
Lay a chopstick each side. Slice thinly across, down to the sticks.
steps.note: The sticks stop the knife cutting all the way through.

steps.instruction: Melt {{ing:butter-block}} with {{ing:fresh-sage}}, crushed {{ing:garlic-clove}}, {{ing:maple-syrup}} and {{ing:chilli-powder}}.
Brush the squash all over, into the cuts.
Roast 45 minutes, brushing twice more, until tender and golden.
Crumble {{ing:feta}} over. Scatter {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}} and toasted {{ing:pumpkin-seeds}}.

swaps.text: Olive oil and vegan feta-style cheese, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Butternut squash, sage and chestnut risotto
recipes.method_note: Keep the stock hot and add it a ladle at a time. Stirring gives the creaminess.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Peel and dice half of {{ing:butternut-squash}}.
Toss with 1 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}} and chopped {{ing:fresh-sage}}. Roast 25 minutes.
Grate the other half of the squash coarsely.
Heat {{ing:stock-vegetable}} in a pan. Keep it hot on a low heat.
Chop {{ing:onion-medium}}. Fry in the rest of the oil 6 minutes, until soft.
Stir in {{ing:rice-arborio-dry}} and the grated squash. Stir 1 minute.
Add {{ing:wine-white}}. Stir until absorbed.
Add the stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 20 minutes.
steps.note: Wait until each ladle is nearly absorbed before the next.

steps.instruction: Stir in grated {{ing:parmesan}} and {{ing:butter-block}}. Season. Rest 2 minutes.
Top with the roast squash and crumbled {{ing:chestnuts-cooked}}.

swaps.text: Most Parmesan uses animal rennet; choose a vegetarian Italian-style hard cheese
More stock and a squeeze of lemon, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Butternut squash, chickpea and spinach curry
recipes.method_note: Mild and warming. Good for a crowd on Christmas Eve or Boxing Day.

steps.instruction: Put a large pan on a medium heat. Add {{ing:vegetable-oil}}.
Chop {{ing:onion-medium}}. Fry 8 minutes, until golden.
Grate in {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:ginger-fresh}}. Add {{ing:curry-powder}}. Stir 1 minute.
Peel and cube {{ing:butternut-squash}}. Add with {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}} and {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}}.
Simmer 20 minutes, until the squash is tender.
Cook {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}} the way the packet says.
Drain {{ing:chickpeas-tinned}}. Add with {{ing:spinach}}. Cook 3 minutes.
Squeeze in {{ing:lime}}. Season. Serve with the rice.

swaps.text: Check the label says gluten free, if you need it
Sweet potato

recipes.name: Roast goose with apples and sage
recipes.method_note: Goose gives off a lot of fat. Pour it off as it roasts: it makes the best roast potatoes.

steps.instruction: Take {{ing:goose}} (about 4.5 kg) out of the fridge 1 hour before.
Heat the oven to 220C.
Prick the skin all over, not into the meat. Rub with salt.
Quarter {{ing:apple-medium}}, {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:orange}}. Push half inside with {{ing:fresh-sage}}.
Put the rest in a roasting tin. Sit the goose on a rack over them.
Roast 30 minutes.
Turn the oven to 180C. Roast 2 hours more.
steps.note: Pour off the fat every 40 minutes into a heatproof jar.

steps.instruction: Check the thickest part reads 75C. Rest under foil 30 minutes.
Spoon the fat off the tin. Add {{ing:cider-dry}} and {{ing:redcurrant-jelly}}.
Boil on the hob 5 minutes, scraping up the bits. Strain to serve.

swaps.text: Cloudy apple juice, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Roast pheasant with bacon, juniper and bread sauce
recipes.method_note: Pheasant is lean. The bacon keeps it moist; do not overcook it.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Crush {{ing:juniper-berries}}. Push inside {{ing:pheasant}} (two birds) with {{ing:fresh-thyme}}.
Rub with {{ing:olive-oil}}. Season.
Lay {{ing:bacon-streaky-raw}} over the breasts.
Roast 40 minutes, until the juices run clear.
Lift onto a board. Rest under foil 10 minutes.
Put the tin on the hob. Add {{ing:wine-red}}. Scrape up the bits.
Add {{ing:stock-chicken}} and {{ing:redcurrant-jelly}}. Boil 5 minutes. Season.
Carve each bird in half down the backbone. Serve with the gravy and bread sauce.

swaps.text: Two guinea fowl, roasted 55 minutes
More stock, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Leg of lamb with rosemary, garlic and anchovy
recipes.method_note: The anchovies melt away and season the meat. Nobody will taste fish.

steps.instruction: Take {{ing:lamb-leg}} out of the fridge 1 hour before.
Heat the oven to 220C.
Make 12 small cuts in the lamb with a sharp knife.
Push slivers of {{ing:garlic-clove}}, sprigs of {{ing:fresh-rosemary}} and bits of {{ing:anchovy-fillet}} into each.
Rub with {{ing:olive-oil}} and pepper. Sit on sliced {{ing:onion-medium}} in a tin.
Roast 20 minutes. Turn to 180C.
Roast 1 hour for pink, 1 hour 20 for well done.
Rest under foil 20 minutes.
Add {{ing:wine-red}} and {{ing:stock-chicken}} to the tin. Boil 5 minutes for the gravy.

swaps.text: Leave them out; add more salt

recipes.name: Venison, red wine and juniper casserole
recipes.method_note: Better made the day before. Venison is lean, so cook it slowly.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 160C.
Toss {{ing:venison-diced}} in {{ing:flour-plain}} and salt.
Brown in batches in {{ing:olive-oil}} in a casserole dish. Set aside.
steps.note: Crowding the pan steams the meat instead of browning it.

steps.instruction: Snip in {{ing:bacon-streaky-raw}}. Fry 3 minutes.
Chop {{ing:onion-medium}}, {{ing:carrot-medium}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Fry 8 minutes.
Add crushed {{ing:juniper-berries}}, {{ing:wine-red}}, {{ing:stock-chicken}} and {{ing:bay-leaf}}.
Return the meat. Bring to a simmer. Cover.
Cook in the oven 2 hours.
Add halved {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}} and {{ing:redcurrant-jelly}}. Cook 30 minutes more.
Season. Serve with mash or roast potatoes.

swaps.text: Beef braising steak, cooked 30 minutes longer
Cornflour, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Slow-roast pork belly with crackling and apples
recipes.method_note: Dry skin crackles. Leave it uncovered in the fridge overnight if you can.

steps.instruction: Score the skin of {{ing:pork-belly}} in lines 1 cm apart. Pat very dry.
Heat the oven to 220C.
Crush {{ing:fennel-seeds}} with {{ing:salt}}. Rub into the skin and cuts.
Quarter {{ing:apple-medium}} and {{ing:onion-medium}}. Put in a tin with {{ing:fresh-sage}}.
Sit the pork on top, skin up. Roast 30 minutes.
Turn the oven to 160C. Pour {{ing:cider-dry}} around, not over, the pork.
Roast 2 hours, until very tender.
Turn up to 230C for 15 minutes if the skin needs to crackle more.
Rest 15 minutes. Cut into squares with the soft apples.

swaps.text: Apple juice, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Roast beef with mustard and thyme
recipes.method_note: Topside is lean: roast it pink and slice it thinly.

steps.instruction: Take {{ing:beef-topside}} out of the fridge 1 hour before.
Heat the oven to 220C.
Rub with {{ing:olive-oil}}, {{ing:mustard-dijon}}, {{ing:fresh-thyme}} leaves, {{ing:black-pepper-ground}} and salt.
Sit on thickly sliced {{ing:onion-medium}} in a roasting tin.
Roast 20 minutes. Turn to 180C.
Roast 45 minutes more for medium-rare.
steps.note: About 50C in the middle; 60C for medium.

steps.instruction: Rest under foil 20 minutes.
Add {{ing:wine-red}}, crumbled {{ing:stock-cube}} and {{ing:water}} to the tin. Boil 5 minutes for gravy.
Slice the beef thinly against the grain.

swaps.text: Check the label says gluten free, if you need it

recipes.name: Turkey, leek and ham pie
recipes.method_note: The best thing to do with leftovers. Use any cooked turkey and ham.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}} in a pan. Slice {{ing:leek}}. Cook 8 minutes, until soft.
Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Cook 1 minute.
Stir in {{ing:stock-chicken}} gradually. Simmer 3 minutes, until thick.
Add {{ing:double-cream}}, {{ing:wholegrain-mustard}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}} leaves.
Stir in shredded cooked turkey ({{ing:chicken-breast-roast}}) and torn {{ing:ham-slice}}. Season.
Tip into a pie dish. Cover with {{ing:puff-pastry}}. Trim and crimp the edge.
Brush with beaten {{ing:egg-medium}}. Cut a hole for steam.
Bake 30 minutes, until puffed and golden.

swaps.text: Cooked chicken, or chestnut mushrooms and chestnuts for a vegetarian pie

recipes.name: Boxing Day turkey curry
recipes.method_note: Fast, gentle and warming, using up the cooked turkey.

steps.instruction: Put a large pan on a medium heat. Add {{ing:vegetable-oil}}.
Slice {{ing:onion-medium}}. Fry 10 minutes, until golden.
Grate in {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:ginger-fresh}}. Add {{ing:garam-masala}} and {{ing:turmeric-ground}}. Stir 1 minute.
Add {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}}. Simmer 10 minutes.
Cook {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}} the way the packet says.
Add shredded cooked turkey ({{ing:chicken-breast-roast}}). Heat 5 minutes, until piping hot.
Take off the heat. Stir in {{ing:natural-yoghurt}} and {{ing:cranberry-sauce}}.
Scatter {{ing:fresh-coriander}}. Serve with the rice.

swaps.text: Coconut milk, to make it dairy free
Chickpeas and roast squash, for a vegetarian curry

recipes.name: Bubble and squeak cakes with fried eggs
recipes.method_note: Leftover roast potatoes and sprouts, crisped in a pan. Boxing Day brunch.

steps.instruction: Shred cooked {{ing:brussels-sprouts}} (or any leftover greens).
Mix with {{ing:mashed-potato}}, sliced {{ing:spring-onion}} and {{ing:wholegrain-mustard}}. Season.
Shape into 8 flat cakes.
Heat {{ing:vegetable-oil}} in a frying pan on a medium heat.
Fry the cakes 4 minutes a side, until crisp and golden.
Fry {{ing:egg-medium}} in the same pan.
Serve each two cakes with an egg and {{ing:brown-sauce}}.

swaps.text: Grilled mushrooms and tomatoes, for a vegan version (check the mash has no butter or milk)

recipes.name: Salmon en croûte with spinach and crème fraîche
recipes.method_note: Assemble the night before and keep it chilled. Bake on the day.

steps.instruction: Wilt {{ing:spinach}} in a dry pan. Squeeze out every drop of water. Chop.
Mix with {{ing:creme-fraiche}}, the zest of {{ing:lemon}}, {{ing:fresh-dill}} and {{ing:nutmeg}}. Season.
Heat the oven to 200C. Lay one sheet of {{ing:puff-pastry}} on a lined tray.
Lay {{ing:salmon-fillet}} on it. Spread the spinach mix over the top.
Beat {{ing:egg-medium}}. Brush the pastry edge.
Cover with the second sheet. Press to seal. Trim.
Brush with egg. Score a fish-scale pattern with a teaspoon edge.
Bake 35 minutes, until deep golden.
Rest 5 minutes before slicing.

swaps.text: Cream cheese

recipes.name: Herb-crusted cod with Puy lentils and salsa verde
recipes.method_note: Lentils can be cooked a day ahead and warmed through.

steps.instruction: Rinse {{ing:lentils-green-dry}}. Simmer in {{ing:stock-vegetable}} with {{ing:bay-leaf}} 25 minutes, until tender.
Heat the oven to 200C.
Chop {{ing:fresh-parsley}}, {{ing:capers}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}} finely.
Mix with the juice of {{ing:lemon}} and 4 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Lay {{ing:cod-fillet}} on a lined tray. Season.
Mix {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}} with 2 tbsp of the salsa and the rest of the oil. Press on top.
Bake 12 minutes, until the fish flakes.
Drain the lentils. Stir in 2 tbsp salsa. Serve with the fish and the rest.

swaps.text: Chopped almonds, for a gluten-free version
Hake, haddock or salmon

recipes.name: Monkfish wrapped in pancetta with cannellini beans
recipes.method_note: Monkfish is firm and meaty: a fish course for meat lovers.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Cut {{ing:monkfish}} into 4 pieces. Season with pepper.
Lay leaves of {{ing:fresh-sage}} on each. Wrap in {{ing:bacon-streaky-raw}}.
steps.note: Thin pancetta slices work too.

steps.instruction: Brown in 1 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}} in an ovenproof pan, 2 minutes a side.
Roast 10 minutes, until the fish is white all through.
Warm the rest of the oil with sliced {{ing:garlic-clove}} in a pan.
Add drained {{ing:cannellini-beans-tinned}} and halved {{ing:cherry-tomato}}. Warm 5 minutes.
Add the zest of {{ing:lemon}} and chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}}. Season.
Serve the fish on the beans.

swaps.text: Thick cod loin, roasted 8 minutes

recipes.name: Christmas Eve seafood linguine
recipes.method_note: Italian Christmas Eve tradition. Everything goes in at the end so nothing overcooks.

steps.instruction: Put a large pan of salted water on a high heat.
Cook {{ing:spaghetti-dry}} (linguine) for the time on the packet.
Warm {{ing:olive-oil}} in a large frying pan. Slice {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:chilli-fresh}}. Cook 1 minute.
Add halved {{ing:cherry-tomato}} and {{ing:wine-white}}. Bubble 4 minutes.
Slice {{ing:squid}} into rings. Add with {{ing:king-prawns-raw}}. Cook 2 minutes.
Add {{ing:mussels-cooked}}. Heat 2 minutes.
Drain the pasta, keeping a mug of the water.
Toss the pasta into the sauce with a splash of the water.
Add the zest and juice of {{ing:lemon}} and {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.

swaps.text: Gluten-free pasta, for a gluten-free version
More pasta water and lemon, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Christmas Eve fish pie with smoked haddock and prawns
recipes.method_note: Make up to a day ahead, then bake from the fridge for 10 minutes longer.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Peel {{ing:potato-large}}. Boil 15 minutes, until soft. Drain. Mash with half of {{ing:butter-block}}.
Put {{ing:haddock-smoked}} and {{ing:salmon-fillet}} in a pan with {{ing:milk-whole}} and {{ing:bay-leaf}}.
Simmer gently 5 minutes. Lift out the fish. Keep the milk.
Melt the rest of the butter. Stir in {{ing:cornflour}}. Whisk in the milk.
Simmer 3 minutes, whisking, until thick.
Add {{ing:mustard-dijon}} and chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}}. Season.
Flake the fish into a dish, without skin. Add {{ing:prawns-cooked}}. Pour over the sauce.
Spread the mash on top. Grate over {{ing:cheddar-cheese}}.
Bake 30 minutes, until golden and bubbling.

swaps.text: Any white fish
Check the label says gluten free, if you need it

recipes.name: Lentil and mushroom shepherd's pie with celeriac mash
recipes.method_note: Make it the day before. It reheats beautifully.

steps.instruction: Put a large pan on a medium heat. Add 2 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Chop {{ing:onion-medium}}, {{ing:carrot-medium}} and {{ing:celery-stick}}. Fry 10 minutes.
Chop {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}}. Add with {{ing:fresh-thyme}}. Fry 6 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:tomato-purée}}, rinsed {{ing:lentils-green-dry}} and {{ing:wine-red}}.
Add {{ing:stock-vegetable}} and {{ing:soy-sauce}}. Simmer 35 minutes, until thick.
Peel and chunk {{ing:potato-large}} and {{ing:celeriac}}. Boil 20 minutes, until soft.
Drain. Mash with {{ing:oat-milk}} and the rest of the oil. Season.
Heat the oven to 200C. Tip the filling into a dish. Top with the mash.
Rough up the top with a fork. Bake 30 minutes, until golden.

swaps.text: More stock, for no alcohol (check the wine is labelled vegan)
Tamari, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Mushroom bourguignon
recipes.method_note: All the depth of the beef classic, in half the time.

steps.instruction: Put a casserole dish on a medium-high heat. Add 2 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Cut {{ing:portobello-mushroom}} into chunks. Halve {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}}. Brown in batches. Set aside.
Add the rest of the oil, peeled {{ing:shallot}} and chopped {{ing:carrot-medium}}. Fry 8 minutes.
Add sliced {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:tomato-purée}}. Stir 1 minute.
Pour in {{ing:wine-red}}. Bubble 3 minutes.
Add {{ing:stock-vegetable}}, {{ing:fresh-thyme}}, {{ing:bay-leaf}}, {{ing:soy-sauce}} and the mushrooms.
Simmer 30 minutes, until the shallots are soft.
Mix {{ing:cornflour}} with 2 tbsp cold water. Stir in. Simmer 2 minutes, until glossy.
Season. Serve with mash or crusty bread.

swaps.text: Check it is labelled vegan; or use more stock and 1 tbsp balsamic vinegar
Tamari, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Chestnut, cranberry and sage stuffed portobellos
recipes.method_note: Two mushrooms each make a main; one each makes a starter.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Remove the stalks from {{ing:portobello-mushroom}}. Chop the stalks finely.
Lay the caps on a tray. Brush with 1 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Fry chopped {{ing:onion-medium}}, {{ing:garlic-clove}} and the stalks in the rest of the oil, 8 minutes.
Add chopped {{ing:fresh-sage}}. Crumble in {{ing:chestnuts-cooked}}.
Stir in {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}}, {{ing:dried-cranberries}}, chopped {{ing:pecans}} and the zest of {{ing:lemon}}. Season.
Pile into the caps. Press down.
Bake 20 minutes, until the mushrooms are tender and tops crisp.

swaps.text: Gluten-free breadcrumbs, for a gluten-free version
Leave them out, for a nut-free version

recipes.name: Wild rice, cranberry and pecan stuffed squash
recipes.method_note: Halved squash makes its own serving bowl. Wild rice gives a nutty bite.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Halve {{ing:butternut-squash}} lengthways. Scoop out the seeds.
Brush with 1 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}}. Roast cut side up 45 minutes, until tender.
Cook {{ing:wild-rice}} the way the packet says, about 40 minutes.
Fry sliced {{ing:red-onion}} in the rest of the oil 8 minutes.
Add shredded {{ing:cavolo-nero}} and chopped {{ing:fresh-sage}}. Cook 3 minutes.
Stir in the rice, {{ing:dried-cranberries}}, chopped {{ing:pecans}} and the zest of {{ing:orange}}.
Pile into the squash. Drizzle {{ing:maple-syrup}}. Roast 10 minutes more.

swaps.text: Toasted pumpkin seeds, for a nut-free version

recipes.name: Spinach, ricotta and feta filo pie
recipes.method_note: Greek-style and crisp. Good hot or at room temperature for a buffet.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 190C.
Wilt {{ing:spinach}} in batches in a dry pan. Squeeze out all the water. Chop.
Mix with {{ing:ricotta}}, crumbled {{ing:feta}}, {{ing:egg-medium}} and sliced {{ing:spring-onion}}.
Add {{ing:fresh-dill}} and {{ing:nutmeg}}. Season with pepper.
Brush a 23 cm dish with {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Layer 5 sheets of {{ing:filo-pastry}}, brushing each with oil, overhanging the edge.
Spoon in the filling. Fold the overhang over.
Scrunch the last 3 sheets on top. Brush with oil. Scatter {{ing:sesame-seeds}}.
Bake 40 minutes, until deep golden.

swaps.text: Crumbled firm tofu and vegan feta-style cheese, no egg, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Hasselback potatoes with rosemary
recipes.method_note: Crisp edges, soft middles. A change from roasties.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Lay each of {{ing:potato-medium}} between two chopsticks. Slice thinly down to the sticks.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}} with {{ing:olive-oil}}, crushed {{ing:garlic-clove}} and chopped {{ing:fresh-rosemary}}.
Brush over the potatoes, into the cuts. Season.
Roast 1 hour, brushing twice, until crisp and fanned out.

swaps.text: All olive oil, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Potato dauphinoise
recipes.method_note: Bake ahead and reheat: it slices more neatly the next day.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 160C. Butter a baking dish with {{ing:butter-block}}.
Peel {{ing:potato-large}}. Slice thinly, 3 mm.
Warm {{ing:double-cream}} and {{ing:milk-whole}} with crushed {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:nutmeg}}.
Layer the potato in the dish, seasoning each layer.
Pour over the cream. Press down. Grate {{ing:gruyere}} on top.
Bake 1 hour 30 minutes, until a knife slides through.
Rest 10 minutes before serving.

swaps.text: Leave it out for the classic version

recipes.name: Buttery mustard mash
recipes.method_note: Steam-dry the potatoes before mashing for the fluffiest mash.

steps.instruction: Peel {{ing:potato-large}}. Cut into even chunks.
Boil in salted water 15 minutes, until soft.
Drain. Leave in the pan off the heat 2 minutes to steam dry.
Warm {{ing:milk-whole}} with {{ing:butter-block}}.
Mash the potatoes. Beat in the milk and {{ing:wholegrain-mustard}}. Season.

swaps.text: Olive oil and oat milk, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Sage and onion stuffing balls
recipes.method_note: Vegetarian, so everyone at the table can have them.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 190C. Line a tray.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}}. Chop {{ing:onion-medium}}. Cook 10 minutes, until soft.
Blitz {{ing:bread-slice-medium}} into crumbs.
Mix the crumbs, onion, chopped {{ing:fresh-sage}} and {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.
Add the zest of {{ing:lemon}} and beaten {{ing:egg-medium}}. Season.
Roll into 16 balls. Lay on the tray.
Bake 25 minutes, until golden and crisp.

swaps.text: Two tbsp of oat milk, with olive oil for the butter, for a vegan version
Gluten-free bread, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Sausage, chestnut and cranberry stuffing
recipes.method_note: Bake in a dish rather than in the bird: it cooks evenly and crisps on top.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 190C. Oil a baking dish.
Chop {{ing:onion-medium}}. Fry in {{ing:olive-oil}} 8 minutes. Cool.
Mix {{ing:sausagemeat}} with the onion and crumbled {{ing:chestnuts-cooked}}.
Add {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}}, {{ing:dried-cranberries}}, chopped {{ing:fresh-sage}} and the zest of {{ing:orange}}.
Beat in {{ing:egg-medium}}. Season with pepper.
Press into the dish. Bake 40 minutes, until browned and cooked through.

swaps.text: Gluten-free sausages, skins removed, with gluten-free crumbs, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Maple and thyme glazed carrots
recipes.method_note: Cooked on the hob in 15 minutes, which frees the oven.

steps.instruction: Peel {{ing:carrot-medium}}. Cut into batons.
Put in a wide pan with {{ing:olive-oil}}, the juice of {{ing:orange}} and 100 ml water.
Cover. Simmer 8 minutes, until nearly tender.
Uncover. Add {{ing:maple-syrup}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}.
Boil 5 minutes, tossing, until the liquid becomes a glaze.

recipes.name: Roast sprouts with maple and pecans
recipes.method_note: Roasting turns sprouts sweet and nutty. Even sprout doubters come round.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Trim and halve {{ing:brussels-sprouts}}. Toss with {{ing:olive-oil}} and salt.
Roast cut side down 20 minutes, until charred at the edges.
Add {{ing:pecans}}. Drizzle {{ing:maple-syrup}}. Roast 5 minutes more.
Grate over the zest of {{ing:lemon}}.

swaps.text: Toasted seeds, for a nut-free version

recipes.name: Cauliflower cheese
