recipes.method_note: Cook the cauliflower until only just tender: it finishes in the oven.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Cut {{ing:cauliflower-head}} into florets. Boil 5 minutes. Drain well.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}}. Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Cook 1 minute.
Whisk in {{ing:milk-whole}}. Simmer 3 minutes, until thick.
Stir in {{ing:mustard-dijon}}, {{ing:nutmeg}} and most of {{ing:cheddar-cheese}}.
Put the cauliflower in a dish. Pour over the sauce. Top with the rest of the cheese.
Bake 25 minutes, until bubbling and golden.

swaps.text: Cornflour, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Creamed leeks with nutmeg
recipes.method_note: Ready in 15 minutes on the hob.

steps.instruction: Slice {{ing:leek}} into rings. Wash well.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}} in a pan. Add the leeks.
Cover. Cook on a low heat 10 minutes, until soft.
Stir in {{ing:double-cream}} and {{ing:nutmeg}}. Bubble 2 minutes. Season.

swaps.text: Olive oil and oat cream, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Yorkshire puddings
recipes.method_note: Smoking-hot fat and an oven you do not open: that is the whole secret.

steps.instruction: Whisk {{ing:flour-plain}} and {{ing:egg-medium}} with a pinch of salt.
Whisk in {{ing:milk-whole}} until smooth. Rest 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 230C. Put a little of {{ing:vegetable-oil}} in each hole of a 12-hole tin.
Heat the tin in the oven 10 minutes, until the oil smokes.
Pour the batter in evenly, straight from the jug.
Bake 20 minutes without opening the door, until risen and golden.

swaps.text: Gluten-free plain flour, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Carrot and swede mash with black pepper
recipes.method_note: Leave it a little rough. A Scottish and northern favourite.

steps.instruction: Peel and chunk {{ing:swede}} and {{ing:carrot-medium}}.
Boil 20 minutes, until very soft.
Drain well. Steam dry 2 minutes.
Mash roughly with {{ing:butter-block}}, {{ing:nutmeg}} and plenty of {{ing:black-pepper-ground}}.

swaps.text: Olive oil, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Cavolo nero with garlic and lemon
recipes.method_note: Something green and sharp beside the rich food.

steps.instruction: Strip {{ing:cavolo-nero}} from its stalks. Tear the leaves.
Blanch 2 minutes in boiling water. Drain well.
Warm {{ing:olive-oil}} with sliced {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:chilli-powder}} 1 minute.
Add the greens. Toss 2 minutes.
Squeeze over {{ing:lemon}}. Season.

recipes.name: Red onion marmalade
recipes.method_note: Keeps a month in a sterilised jar in the fridge. Lovely with cheese and cold meats.

steps.instruction: Slice {{ing:red-onion}} thinly.
Cook in {{ing:olive-oil}} on a low heat 30 minutes, stirring, until very soft.
Add {{ing:sugar-muscovado}}, {{ing:balsamic-vinegar}}, {{ing:wine-red}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}.
Simmer 30 minutes, until dark and sticky.
Cool. Spoon into a clean jar.

swaps.text: More balsamic and a splash of water, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Flourless chocolate and chestnut torte
recipes.method_note: Rich and dense. A thin slice goes a long way.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 170C. Line a 23 cm springform tin.
Melt {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}} with {{ing:butter-block}}. Cool slightly.
Blitz {{ing:chestnuts-cooked}} to a paste.
Whisk {{ing:egg-medium}} with {{ing:sugar-caster}} 5 minutes, until thick and pale.
Fold in the chocolate and chestnut paste gently.
Pour into the tin. Bake 30 minutes, until set with a slight wobble.
Cool in the tin. It sinks a little, which is meant to happen.
Dust with {{ing:cocoa-powder}}. Serve with {{ing:creme-fraiche}}.

swaps.text: Oat cream

recipes.name: Christmas tiramisu with Marsala and orange
recipes.method_note: Make it the day before. Uses raw eggs; buy eggs with the British Lion mark.

steps.instruction: Dissolve {{ing:coffee-instant}} in 300 ml boiling water. Add {{ing:sherry}} (Marsala). Cool.
Separate {{ing:egg-medium}}. Whisk the yolks with {{ing:sugar-caster}} until pale.
Beat in {{ing:mascarpone}} and the zest of {{ing:orange}}.
Whisk the whites to stiff peaks. Fold into the mascarpone.
Dip half of {{ing:sponge-fingers}} briefly in the coffee. Lay in a dish.
steps.note: One second each side, or they fall apart.

steps.instruction: Spread half the cream over. Repeat both layers.
Chill at least 6 hours.
Dust with {{ing:cocoa-powder}}. Grate over {{ing:dark-chocolate}}.

swaps.text: More coffee, for no alcohol
Leave out the eggs and fold in 200 ml whipped double cream instead

recipes.name: Sticky gingerbread loaf
recipes.method_note: Better after a day wrapped in foil. Serve warm with custard as a pudding.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 170C. Line a 900 g loaf tin.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}}, {{ing:sugar-muscovado}}, {{ing:black-treacle}} and {{ing:golden-syrup}} gently. Cool 5 minutes.
Mix {{ing:flour-self-raising}}, {{ing:ginger-ground}}, {{ing:mixed-spice}} and {{ing:bicarbonate-of-soda}} in a bowl.
Beat {{ing:egg-medium}} into {{ing:milk-whole}}.
Stir the melted mix and the milk into the flour until smooth.
Stir in chopped {{ing:stem-ginger}}. Pour into the tin.
Bake 50 minutes, until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool in the tin.

swaps.text: Dairy-free spread and oat milk, to make it dairy free

recipes.name: Clementine and almond cake
recipes.method_note: Whole boiled clementines, skin and all. Moist, fragrant and naturally gluten free.

steps.instruction: Put whole {{ing:clementine}} in a pan of water. Simmer 2 hours, topping up.
Drain. Cool. Halve and pick out any pips.
Heat the oven to 190C. Line a 21 cm springform tin.
Blitz the clementines, skin and all, to a pulp.
Beat {{ing:egg-medium}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}}. Stir in the pulp.
Fold in {{ing:ground-almonds}} and {{ing:baking-powder}}.
steps.note: Check the baking powder says gluten free, if you need it.

steps.instruction: Pour into the tin. Bake 1 hour, until firm. Cover with foil if browning.
Cool in the tin. Dust with {{ing:icing-sugar}}. Scatter {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}}.

swaps.text: This cake depends on them; there is no good nut-free swap

recipes.name: Cranberry and orange Bakewell tart
recipes.method_note: Sharp cranberry under almond sponge. Good warm or cold.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Line a 23 cm tart tin with {{ing:shortcrust-pastry}}.
Line with paper and baking beans. Bake 15 minutes. Remove the paper. Bake 5 more.
Turn the oven to 180C. Spread {{ing:cranberry-sauce}} over the base.
Beat {{ing:butter-block}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}}. Beat in {{ing:egg-medium}}.
Fold in {{ing:ground-almonds}}, {{ing:flour-plain}} and the zest of {{ing:orange}}.
Spread over the cranberry. Bake 30 minutes, until golden and set.
Cool. Mix {{ing:icing-sugar}} with orange juice. Drizzle over.

swaps.text: Gluten-free pastry and gluten-free flour, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Baked vanilla cheesecake with cranberry topping
recipes.method_note: Bake the day before. Cooling slowly in the oven stops it cracking.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 160C. Line a 23 cm springform tin.
Crush {{ing:ginger-nut-biscuits}}. Mix with melted {{ing:butter-block}}. Press into the base.
Beat {{ing:cream-cheese}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}} and {{ing:cornflour}} until smooth.
Beat in {{ing:egg-medium}}, {{ing:creme-fraiche}} and {{ing:vanilla-extract}}.
Pour over the base. Bake 50 minutes, until set with a wobble.
Turn off the oven. Leave inside, door ajar, 1 hour.
Chill overnight. Spread {{ing:cranberry-sauce}} on top to serve.

swaps.text: Digestive biscuits, or gluten-free biscuits for a gluten-free base

recipes.name: Black Forest Eton mess
recipes.method_note: Five minutes to put together. Shop-bought meringues are fine.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 110C. Line a tray.
Whisk {{ing:egg-white}} to stiff peaks. Whisk in {{ing:icing-sugar}} a spoonful at a time.
Spoon blobs onto the tray. Bake 1 hour 30 minutes. Cool.
Warm {{ing:cherries}} with {{ing:sugar-caster}} 5 minutes, until juicy. Add {{ing:spirit-40}} (kirsch or brandy). Cool.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}} to soft peaks. Fold in {{ing:greek-yoghurt}}.
Break in the meringues. Ripple through the cherries.
Spoon into glasses. Grate over {{ing:dark-chocolate}}.

swaps.text: Leave it out, for no alcohol
6 shop-bought meringue nests

recipes.name: Apple, blackberry and cinnamon crumble
recipes.method_note: Frozen blackberries are perfect here.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 190C.
Peel, core and chunk {{ing:apple-medium}}. Toss with {{ing:blackberries}}, {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}} and {{ing:cinnamon-ground}}.
Tip into a baking dish.
Rub {{ing:butter-block}} into {{ing:flour-plain}} until it looks like crumbs.
Stir in {{ing:sugar-demerara}} and {{ing:oats-rolled}}. Scatter over the fruit.
Bake 40 minutes, until golden and bubbling.
Serve with warm {{ing:custard-ready}}.

swaps.text: Dairy-free block, with plant custard, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Dark chocolate truffles
recipes.method_note: Made with coconut cream, so they are vegan. A good homemade gift.

steps.instruction: Chop {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}} finely into a bowl.
Heat {{ing:coconut-cream}} until steaming. Pour over the chocolate.
Leave 2 minutes. Stir until smooth. Stir in {{ing:orange-liqueur}}.
Chill 3 hours, until firm.
Scoop teaspoonfuls. Roll into balls with cool hands.
Roll half in {{ing:cocoa-powder}} and half in chopped {{ing:pistachios}}.
Keep in the fridge for up to a week.

swaps.text: Orange zest, for no alcohol
Check the label says vegan if you need it

recipes.name: Spiced winter fruit salad
recipes.method_note: Something fresh after the heavy food. The syrup keeps a week.

steps.instruction: Put {{ing:sugar-caster}}, {{ing:star-anise}}, {{ing:cinnamon-stick}} and sliced {{ing:ginger-fresh}} in a pan with 200 ml water.
Simmer 5 minutes. Cool.
Peel and slice {{ing:clementine}} into rounds.
Slice {{ing:pear}}. Peel and slice {{ing:kiwi}}.
Arrange the fruit in a bowl. Pour over the syrup.
Scatter {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}} and {{ing:fresh-mint}}.

swaps.text: Mango or grapes

recipes.name: Vegan sticky toffee pudding
recipes.method_note: Dates and coconut cream make the toffee. Nobody will know.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Grease a 20 cm square tin.
Simmer chopped {{ing:dates-pitted}} in {{ing:water}} 5 minutes. Stir in {{ing:bicarbonate-of-soda}}.
Beat 75 g of {{ing:dairy-free-spread}} with 150 g of {{ing:sugar-muscovado}}.
Stir in {{ing:flour-self-raising}}, {{ing:oat-milk}}, {{ing:vanilla-extract}} and the dates.
Pour into the tin. Bake 30 minutes, until springy.
Melt the rest of the spread and sugar. Add {{ing:coconut-cream}}. Simmer 3 minutes.
Pour a third over the warm sponge. Serve with the rest.

swaps.text: Gluten-free self-raising flour, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Maple pecan pie
recipes.method_note: Sweet and nutty. Serve with crème fraîche to cut the richness.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 190C. Line a 23 cm tart tin with {{ing:shortcrust-pastry}}.
Bake blind with paper and beans 15 minutes. Remove them. Bake 5 more.
Turn the oven to 170C. Melt {{ing:butter-block}} with {{ing:maple-syrup}}, {{ing:golden-syrup}} and {{ing:sugar-muscovado}}.
Cool 5 minutes. Whisk in {{ing:egg-medium}} and {{ing:vanilla-extract}}.
Scatter {{ing:pecans}} in the case. Pour the filling over.
Bake 35 minutes, until set with a slight wobble.
Cool completely. Serve with {{ing:creme-fraiche}}.

swaps.text: Gluten-free shortcrust, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Lemon posset with ginger crumbs
recipes.method_note: Three ingredients and the fridge. Make it the day before.

steps.instruction: Heat {{ing:double-cream}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}} gently, stirring, until the sugar dissolves.
Bring to the boil. Bubble 3 minutes.
Take off the heat. Stir in the zest and juice of {{ing:lemon}}.
steps.note: The lemon sets the cream.

steps.instruction: Cool 10 minutes. Pour into 6 small glasses.
Chill at least 4 hours, until set.
Crush {{ing:ginger-nut-biscuits}}. Scatter on top to serve.

swaps.text: Gluten-free biscuits, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Chocolate fondants with a molten middle
recipes.method_note: Make up to a day ahead and bake from the fridge, adding 2 minutes.

steps.instruction: Butter six pudding moulds well. Dust with {{ing:cocoa-powder}}.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}} with {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}}. Cool 5 minutes.
Whisk {{ing:egg-medium}}, {{ing:egg-yolk}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}} until thick and pale.
Fold in the chocolate, then {{ing:flour-plain}}.
Divide between the moulds. Chill at least 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 200C. Bake 12 minutes, until risen with a soft top.
Rest 1 minute. Turn out onto plates.

swaps.text: Gluten-free plain flour, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Honey-baked figs with mascarpone and pistachios
recipes.method_note: Fifteen minutes from start to plate.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Cut a cross in the top of each of {{ing:figs-fresh}}. Squeeze open.
Sit in a dish. Drizzle {{ing:honey}} and the juice of {{ing:orange}}. Dust with {{ing:cinnamon-ground}}.
Bake 12 minutes, until soft and juicy.
Serve with {{ing:mascarpone}} and chopped {{ing:pistachios}}.

swaps.text: Thick coconut yoghurt, with maple for honey, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Gingerbread biscuits
recipes.method_note: Children love cutting and icing these. They keep a week in a tin.

steps.instruction: Mix {{ing:flour-plain}}, {{ing:ginger-ground}}, {{ing:cinnamon-ground}} and {{ing:bicarbonate-of-soda}}.
Rub in {{ing:butter-block}}. Stir in {{ing:sugar-soft-brown}}.
Beat {{ing:egg-medium}} with {{ing:golden-syrup}}. Stir in to make a dough.
Chill 15 minutes.
Heat the oven to 180C. Roll to 5 mm. Cut out shapes.
Bake 10 minutes, until golden.
steps.note: They harden as they cool.

steps.instruction: Cool. Mix {{ing:icing-sugar}} with a little water. Pipe on decorations.

swaps.text: Dairy-free block and 3 tbsp aquafaba, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Christmas rocky road
recipes.method_note: No baking. Cut into small squares; it is rich.

steps.instruction: Line a 20 cm square tin with baking paper.
Melt {{ing:dark-chocolate}}, {{ing:milk-chocolate-bar}}, {{ing:butter-block}} and {{ing:golden-syrup}} gently.
Break {{ing:digestive-biscuit}} into small pieces.
Stir in the biscuits, halved {{ing:glace-cherries}}, {{ing:dried-cranberries}} and {{ing:pistachios}}.
Press into the tin. Chill 3 hours, until set.
Dust with {{ing:icing-sugar}}. Cut into 12 squares.

swaps.text: Add 75 g mini marshmallows if you like; most contain gelatine
Gluten-free biscuits, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Apple and mincemeat crumble
recipes.method_note: Christmas in a crumble. A good use for a half jar of mincemeat.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 190C.
Peel, core and slice {{ing:apple-medium}}. Mix with {{ing:mincemeat}}. Tip into a dish.
Rub {{ing:butter-block}} into {{ing:flour-plain}}. Stir in {{ing:sugar-demerara}} and {{ing:ground-almonds}} (flaked).
Scatter over the fruit.
Bake 35 minutes, until golden.
Serve with warm {{ing:custard-ready}}.

swaps.text: Dairy-free block and vegetarian mincemeat, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Vegan chocolate chestnut log
recipes.method_note: An egg-free chocolate sponge rolled round sweet chestnut. Rich and festive.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Line a 23 x 33 cm Swiss roll tin.
Mix {{ing:flour-self-raising}}, 25 g of {{ing:cocoa-powder}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}} and {{ing:bicarbonate-of-soda}}.
Whisk {{ing:oat-milk}}, {{ing:vegetable-oil}} and {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}}. Stir into the dry mix.
Spread in the tin. Bake 12 minutes, until springy.
Roll up warm in baking paper from a short end. Cool.
Blend {{ing:chestnuts-cooked}} with {{ing:maple-syrup}} and 3 tbsp water until smooth.
Melt {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}} with {{ing:coconut-cream}} and the rest of the cocoa. Cool until spreadable.
Unroll. Spread with the chestnut. Roll up again.
Cover with the icing. Fork into bark lines.

swaps.text: Check the label says vegan if you need it

recipes.name: Espresso martini
recipes.method_note: Shake hard with plenty of ice for the foam on top.

steps.instruction: Make 60 ml strong espresso from {{ing:coffee-ground}}. Stir in {{ing:sugar-caster}}. Cool.
Fill a cocktail shaker with ice.
Add the coffee, {{ing:spirit-40}} (vodka) and {{ing:orange-liqueur}} (or a coffee liqueur).
Shake hard for 20 seconds.
Strain into two chilled glasses.

swaps.text: Cold coffee shaken with ice and a little maple syrup, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Mulled white wine with elderflower
recipes.method_note: Lighter and fruitier than the red. Good with fish.

steps.instruction: Pour {{ing:wine-white}}, {{ing:apple-juice}} and {{ing:elderflower-cordial}} into a large pan.
Add sliced {{ing:orange}} and {{ing:ginger-fresh}}, {{ing:star-anise}} and {{ing:cinnamon-stick}}.
Warm on a low heat 15 minutes, without boiling.
Ladle into heatproof glasses.

swaps.text: Check it is labelled vegan if you need it

recipes.name: Spiced rum punch
recipes.method_note: For a party. Make the base ahead and add the fizz at the last minute.

steps.instruction: Peel and chunk {{ing:pineapple}}. Put in a large jug or bowl.
Add {{ing:spirit-40}} (spiced or dark rum), {{ing:orange-juice}} and the juice of {{ing:lime}}.
Add {{ing:cinnamon-stick}}. Chill at least 1 hour.
Add ice. Top up with {{ing:ginger-beer}}.
Grate over {{ing:nutmeg}}. Serve.

swaps.text: More orange juice, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Clementine bellini
recipes.method_note: Freshly squeezed clementine juice is the whole difference.

steps.instruction: Squeeze the juice of {{ing:clementine}}. Strain.
Stir in {{ing:orange-liqueur}}.
Pour 30 ml into each chilled flute.
Top up slowly with {{ing:sparkling-wine}}.

swaps.text: Sparkling elderflower or sparkling water, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Hot toddy with honey and clove
recipes.method_note: A soothing nightcap.

steps.instruction: Stud two slices of {{ing:lemon}} with {{ing:cloves}}.
Put one in each mug with {{ing:honey}}, half of {{ing:cinnamon-stick}} and the rest of the lemon juice.
Add 25 ml of {{ing:spirit-40}} (whisky) to each.
Top up with 200 ml hot water. Stir.

swaps.text: Leave it out for a honey and lemon soother

recipes.name: Gingerbread latte
recipes.method_note: A coffee-shop Christmas drink, made at home.

steps.instruction: Make two shots of espresso from {{ing:coffee-ground}}.
Stir in {{ing:golden-syrup}}, {{ing:ginger-ground}} and {{ing:cinnamon-ground}}.
Heat and froth {{ing:milk-whole}}.
Pour the coffee into two mugs. Top with the milk.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}} lightly. Spoon on top.

swaps.text: Oat milk and oat cream, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Cranberry and mint mojito (no alcohol)
recipes.method_note: Fresh, sharp and festive red.

steps.instruction: Cut {{ing:lime}} into wedges. Divide between four glasses.
Add {{ing:fresh-mint}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}} and a few {{ing:cranberries}}.
Crush gently with the end of a rolling pin.
Fill with ice. Add {{ing:cranberry-juice}}.
Top up with {{ing:sparkling-water}}. Stir.

swaps.text: Add 25 ml white rum to each glass, for a classic mojito

recipes.name: Apple, ginger and rosemary sparkle
recipes.method_note: A soft drink for the roast.

steps.instruction: Simmer {{ing:sugar-caster}}, sliced {{ing:ginger-fresh}} and {{ing:fresh-rosemary}} in 100 ml water 5 minutes. Cool.
Strain the syrup into a jug with {{ing:apple-juice}}.
Pour over ice. Top up with {{ing:ginger-ale}}.
Add a rosemary sprig to each glass.

recipes.name: Hot spiced orange and clove tea
recipes.method_note: Warming and caffeine-light.

steps.instruction: Put {{ing:tea-bags}}, {{ing:cloves}}, {{ing:cinnamon-stick}} and strips of zest from {{ing:orange}} in a jug.
Pour over 700 ml boiling water. Brew 4 minutes.
Strain into a pan. Add {{ing:orange-juice}} and {{ing:honey}}.
Warm through. Pour into mugs.

swaps.text: Maple syrup, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Spiced vegan hot chocolate
recipes.method_note: Oat milk and a pinch of chilli make it rich and warming.

steps.instruction: Warm {{ing:oat-milk}} in a pan until steaming.
Whisk in {{ing:cocoa-powder}}, {{ing:cinnamon-ground}} and {{ing:cayenne-pepper}}.
Break in {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}}. Whisk until melted.
Sweeten with {{ing:maple-syrup}}. Pour into mugs.

swaps.text: Check the label says vegan if you need it

recipes.name: Oysters with shallot and red wine mignonette
recipes.method_note: Buy oysters from a fishmonger the day you eat them, and keep them cupped side down in the fridge.

steps.instruction: Chop {{ing:shallot}} as finely as you can.
Mix with {{ing:wine-red}}, {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}} and crushed {{ing:black-peppercorns}}. Chill 30 minutes.
Hold each of {{ing:oysters}} in a folded tea towel, flat side up.
steps.note: The towel protects your hand if the knife slips.

steps.instruction: Push an oyster knife into the hinge. Twist to pop it open.
Slide the knife under the oyster to free it. Keep the juice.
Lay on crushed ice. Spoon a little mignonette onto each.
Serve with wedges of {{ing:lemon}}.

swaps.text: Grill them 3 minutes with a little garlic butter, for anyone who should avoid raw shellfish

recipes.name: Scallop crudo with yuzu, chilli and olive oil
recipes.method_note: Very fresh, sashimi-grade scallops only. Slice them cold from the fridge.

steps.instruction: Chill four plates for 20 minutes.
Slice each of {{ing:scallops}} across into 3 thin discs.
Fan them over the cold plates.
Spoon over {{ing:yuzu-juice}} and {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Scatter very finely sliced {{ing:chilli-fresh}}, {{ing:chives}} and {{ing:salt}} (flaky sea salt).
Serve at once.

swaps.text: Half lime, half grapefruit juice
Sear them 60 seconds a side first, for anyone who should avoid raw shellfish

recipes.name: Grilled langoustines with garlic and tarragon butter
recipes.method_note: Messy, generous and worth it. Put out finger bowls.

steps.instruction: Heat the grill to its highest.
Split {{ing:langoustines}} in half lengthways with a heavy knife.
Mash {{ing:butter-block}} with crushed {{ing:garlic-clove}}, chopped {{ing:fresh-tarragon}} and lemon zest.
Lay the halves cut side up on a tray. Dot with the butter.
Grill 3 minutes, until the flesh turns white.
Squeeze over {{ing:lemon}}. Serve with {{ing:sourdough}} for the butter.

swaps.text: Large raw king prawns, butterflied

recipes.name: Beef carpaccio with truffle oil, rocket and Parmesan
recipes.method_note: Freeze the fillet for 30 minutes before slicing so it cuts paper thin.

steps.instruction: Rub {{ing:beef-fillet}} with {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:black-pepper-ground}}.
Sear in a very hot pan 30 seconds a side. Cool.
Wrap tightly. Freeze 30 minutes, until firm.
Slice as thinly as possible with your sharpest knife.
Lay the slices between baking paper. Press thinner with a rolling pin.
Arrange on plates. Scatter {{ing:rocket}} and {{ing:capers}}.
Shave over {{ing:parmesan}}. Drizzle {{ing:truffle-oil}} and squeeze over {{ing:lemon}}.

swaps.text: Leave it out, for a dairy-free version
Thin slices of roasted beetroot, for a vegetarian carpaccio

recipes.name: Tuna tartare with avocado, sesame and lime
recipes.method_note: Use sashimi-grade tuna. Dice it as close to serving as you can.

steps.instruction: Dice {{ing:tuna-steak}} into 5 mm cubes. Keep cold.
Mix {{ing:soy-sauce}}, {{ing:sesame-oil}}, grated {{ing:ginger-fresh}} and half the juice of {{ing:lime}}.
Stir the dressing and sliced {{ing:spring-onion}} through the tuna.
Dice {{ing:avocado}}. Toss with the rest of the lime and a pinch of salt.
Press the avocado into a ring on each plate. Top with tuna. Lift the ring.
Scatter toasted {{ing:sesame-seeds}} and snipped {{ing:nori}}.

swaps.text: Tamari, for a gluten-free version
Sashimi-grade salmon

recipes.name: Burrata with blood orange, pistachio and honey
recipes.method_note: Take burrata out of the fridge 30 minutes before so it is soft and creamy.

steps.instruction: Cut the peel and pith off {{ing:grapefruit}} (blood oranges). Slice into rounds.
Arrange on a platter. Tear {{ing:burrata}} open on top.
Drizzle {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:honey}}.
Scatter chopped {{ing:pistachios}} and torn {{ing:fresh-mint}}. Season with flaky salt and pepper.

swaps.text: Clementines or pink grapefruit

recipes.name: Blinis with smoked salmon, crème fraîche and caviar
recipes.method_note: Salmon or trout roe gives the same pop for less.

steps.instruction: Warm {{ing:blinis}} in a 180C oven 4 minutes.
Stir finely chopped {{ing:chives}} and lemon zest into {{ing:creme-fraiche}}.
Put a small spoon of cream on each blini.
Fold a ribbon of {{ing:smoked-salmon-cold}} on top.
Finish each with a little {{ing:caviar}}. Serve with wedges of {{ing:lemon}}.

swaps.text: Finely chopped dill and black pepper

recipes.name: Chicken liver parfait with port jelly and brioche
recipes.method_note: Silky and rich. Pushing it through a sieve is what makes it parfait, not pâté.

steps.instruction: Melt 25 g of {{ing:butter-unsalted}}. Fry chopped {{ing:shallot}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}} 5 minutes.
Add {{ing:port}} and {{ing:spirit-40}} (brandy). Boil until syrupy.
Fry trimmed {{ing:chicken-livers}} in a hot pan 2 minutes a side, pink inside.
Blend livers and shallots with the rest of the butter, melted, until smooth.
Push through a fine sieve with a spatula. Season well.
Pour into a dish. Chill 2 hours, until set.
Melt {{ing:redcurrant-jelly}} with 2 tbsp port. Cool. Pour over the top. Chill again.
Serve with toasted {{ing:brioche}}.

swaps.text: Apple juice and a splash of balsamic, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Crab cocktail with pink grapefruit and avocado
recipes.method_note: Grapefruit cuts the richness of crab and mayonnaise.

steps.instruction: Mix {{ing:mayonnaise}}, {{ing:tomato-ketchup}} and {{ing:cayenne-pepper}}.
Fold in {{ing:crab-white-meat}} gently.
Cut segments from {{ing:grapefruit}}, leaving the skin between them behind.
Dice {{ing:avocado}}. Shred {{ing:cos-lettuce}}.
Layer lettuce, avocado and grapefruit in glasses.
Top with the crab. Scatter {{ing:chives}}.

swaps.text: Cooked lobster or prawns

recipes.name: Sticky pomegranate quail with freekeh salad
recipes.method_note: Spatchcocked quail cooks in 12 minutes. Eat with your fingers.

steps.instruction: Cut out the backbone of each of {{ing:quail}} with scissors. Press flat.
Mix {{ing:pomegranate-molasses}}, crushed {{ing:garlic-clove}}, {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:cumin-ground}}. Coat the quail.
Leave 30 minutes.
Cover {{ing:couscous-dry}} with 150 ml boiling water. Leave 5 minutes. Fluff.
Stir in {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}}, chopped {{ing:fresh-parsley}} and the juice of {{ing:lemon}}.
Heat the grill to high. Grill the quail skin up 6 minutes a side.
steps.note: The juices should run clear.

steps.instruction: Rest 3 minutes. Serve on the salad.

swaps.text: Freekeh or quinoa; quinoa for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Salt-baked beetroot with whipped goats' cheese and hazelnuts
recipes.method_note: Baking in a salt crust makes beetroot dense and sweet.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Mix {{ing:salt}} and {{ing:flour-plain}} with 200 ml water into a stiff dough.
Wrap each of {{ing:beetroot-raw}} completely in dough. Bake 1 hour 30 minutes.
Crack open the crust. Peel the beetroot. Cut into wedges.
steps.note: The crust is not for eating.

steps.instruction: Whip {{ing:goats-cheese}} with {{ing:creme-fraiche}} until smooth.
Spread on plates. Add the beetroot. Drizzle {{ing:honey}} and {{ing:balsamic-vinegar}}.
Scatter toasted, crushed {{ing:hazelnuts}}.

swaps.text: Wrap the beetroot in foil instead; still good
The flour is only for the crust, which is thrown away; use foil if you need to avoid it in the kitchen

recipes.name: Jerusalem artichoke soup with truffle oil
recipes.method_note: Velvety and nutty. The truffle oil is a few drops, not a pour.

steps.instruction: Peel {{ing:jerusalem-artichoke}}. Drop into water with the juice of {{ing:lemon}}.
steps.note: Lemon stops them turning brown.

steps.instruction: Melt {{ing:butter-block}}. Fry chopped {{ing:shallot}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}} 5 minutes.
Add the drained artichokes and {{ing:stock-vegetable}}. Simmer 20 minutes, until soft.
Blend until very smooth. Stir in {{ing:double-cream}}. Season.
Serve with a few drops of {{ing:truffle-oil}} and {{ing:chives}}.

swaps.text: Olive oil and oat cream, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Caramelised chicory tarte tatin with blue cheese
recipes.method_note: Bitter-sweet and rich. Turn it out while still warm.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}} in a 24 cm ovenproof pan until golden.
Halve {{ing:chicory}} lengthways. Lay cut side down in the caramel.
Cook 8 minutes, until softening. Add {{ing:balsamic-vinegar}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}.
Cover with {{ing:puff-pastry}}. Tuck the edges down the sides.
Bake 25 minutes, until puffed and golden.
Rest 2 minutes. Turn out onto a plate.
steps.note: Use oven gloves and a plate bigger than the pan.

steps.instruction: Scatter crumbled {{ing:stilton}} and {{ing:walnuts}}.

swaps.text: Vegan blue cheese and vegan pastry, with olive oil for butter, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Dill and pink peppercorn gravlax with sweet mustard sauce
recipes.method_note: Two days of curing in the fridge. The sauce is the Scandinavian classic.

steps.instruction: Mix {{ing:salt}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}}, crushed {{ing:black-peppercorns}} and half of {{ing:fresh-dill}}.
Rub over {{ing:salmon-fillet}}. Sprinkle with {{ing:spirit-40}} (aquavit or vodka).
Wrap tightly. Chill 48 hours, weighted, turning daily.
Whisk {{ing:mustard-dijon}}, {{ing:honey}} and {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}}. Whisk in {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Stir in a third of the remaining dill.
Scrape off the cure. Coat the salmon in the rest of the dill.
Slice thinly. Serve with the sauce and rye bread.

swaps.text: Leave it out, for no alcohol

recipes.name: King prawn tempura with chilli and lime dip
recipes.method_note: Ice-cold water and a lumpy batter are the secret to a light crust.

steps.instruction: Mix {{ing:sweet-chilli-sauce}}, the juice of {{ing:lime}} and {{ing:fish-sauce}} for the dip.
Heat 5 cm of vegetable oil in a deep pan to 180C.
steps.note: Nutrition counts only the oil the food soaks up. Never leave hot oil.

steps.instruction: Whisk {{ing:flour-plain}} and {{ing:cornflour}} with ice-cold {{ing:sparkling-water}}. Leave lumpy.
Dip {{ing:king-prawns-raw}} by the tail into the batter.
Fry 4 at a time, 2 minutes, until pale golden and crisp.
Drain on kitchen paper. Serve hot with the dip.

swaps.text: Rice flour, for a gluten-free version (check the fish and chilli sauces)

recipes.name: Seared venison with juniper, blackberries and celeriac
recipes.method_note: Venison loin is lean and tender. Sear hard and serve pink.

steps.instruction: Crush {{ing:juniper-berries}} and {{ing:black-peppercorns}}. Press over {{ing:venison-diced}} (a loin piece).
Sear in a very hot pan with 1 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}}, 1 minute a side.
Rest 10 minutes. Slice thinly.
Cut {{ing:celeriac}} into fine matchsticks. Toss with {{ing:mustard-dijon}}, lemon juice and the rest of the oil.
Arrange venison and celeriac on plates.
Scatter halved {{ing:blackberries}} and {{ing:watercress}}. Squeeze over {{ing:lemon}}.

swaps.text: Beef fillet

recipes.name: Miso-glazed aubergine with sesame
recipes.method_note: Nasu dengaku: the Japanese classic. Sticky, savoury, irresistible.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Halve {{ing:aubergine}} lengthways. Score the flesh in a criss-cross.
Brush with {{ing:vegetable-oil}}. Roast cut side up 25 minutes, until soft.
Mix {{ing:miso-paste}}, {{ing:mirin}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}}.
Spread over the aubergine. Grill 3 minutes, until bubbling.
Scatter {{ing:sesame-seeds}} and sliced {{ing:spring-onion}}.

swaps.text: Check the label says gluten free, if you need it

recipes.name: Wild mushroom and Gruyère tartlets with truffle
recipes.method_note: Crisp pastry, buttery mushrooms, nutty cheese.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Soak {{ing:shiitake-dried}} in boiling water 10 minutes. Chop.
Cut {{ing:puff-pastry}} into 6 squares. Score a 1 cm border. Lay on a tray.
Fry sliced {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}} in {{ing:butter-block}} 6 minutes, until golden.
Add the soaked mushrooms, crushed {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}. Fry 2 minutes.
Spread {{ing:creme-fraiche}} inside each border. Pile on the mushrooms.
Grate over {{ing:gruyere}}. Bake 18 minutes, until puffed.
Finish with a drop of {{ing:truffle-oil}}.

swaps.text: Most Gruyère uses animal rennet; choose a vegetarian alpine-style cheese

recipes.name: Sea bream ceviche with chilli, lime and coriander
recipes.method_note: Lime "cooks" the fish in minutes. Use the freshest fish.

steps.instruction: Skin {{ing:sea-bream}}. Cut into 1 cm pieces. Put in a cold glass bowl.
Slice {{ing:red-onion}} paper thin. Chop {{ing:chilli-fresh}}.
Squeeze over the juice of {{ing:lime}}. Add {{ing:salt}}, onion and chilli.
Chill 10 minutes, until the fish turns opaque.
Stir in diced {{ing:avocado}} and {{ing:fresh-coriander}}.
Drizzle {{ing:olive-oil}}. Serve straight away.

swaps.text: Sea bass or scallops

recipes.name: Figs, prosciutto and burrata with honey
recipes.method_note: An Italian antipasto that needs no cooking.

steps.instruction: Quarter {{ing:figs-fresh}}.
Arrange {{ing:rocket}}, figs and draped {{ing:prosciutto}} on a platter.
Tear {{ing:burrata}} into the middle.
Drizzle {{ing:honey}}, {{ing:balsamic-vinegar}} and {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Scatter {{ing:walnuts}}. Season with pepper.

swaps.text: Leave it out and add grilled peaches, for a vegetarian platter

recipes.name: Lobster and brandy bisque
recipes.method_note: Roasting the shells is where the deep flavour comes from.

steps.instruction: Take the meat out of {{ing:lobster-tail}}. Chop and chill it. Keep the shells.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}}. Fry the shells 5 minutes, until red.
Add chopped {{ing:onion-medium}}, {{ing:carrot-medium}} and {{ing:celery-stick}}. Fry 8 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:tomato-purée}}. Add {{ing:spirit-40}} (brandy). Bubble 1 minute.
Add {{ing:wine-white}} and {{ing:stock-chicken}}. Simmer 30 minutes.
Blend everything, shells too. Push through a sieve, pressing hard.
steps.note: Blend in short bursts; the shells are noisy.

steps.instruction: Stir in {{ing:double-cream}} and {{ing:cayenne-pepper}}. Add the lobster meat. Warm 2 minutes.
Serve with {{ing:fresh-tarragon}} on top.

swaps.text: Leave it out, for no alcohol
Shell-on king prawns, the shells roasted the same way

recipes.name: Chestnut velouté with porcini and crème fraîche
recipes.method_note: A soup with the depth of a forest floor.

steps.instruction: Soak {{ing:shiitake-dried}} (porcini) in 300 ml boiling water for 20 minutes.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}}. Fry chopped {{ing:shallot}} and {{ing:celery-stick}} 8 minutes.
Add {{ing:chestnuts-cooked}}, the mushrooms, their strained water and {{ing:stock-vegetable}}.
Add {{ing:fresh-thyme}}. Simmer 20 minutes.
Take out the thyme. Blend until velvety. Stir in {{ing:sherry}}.
Serve with a swirl of {{ing:creme-fraiche}}.

swaps.text: Olive oil and oat cream, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Seared scallops with cauliflower purée and crisp prosciutto
recipes.method_note: A restaurant classic. Sweet scallop, silky cauliflower, salty crunch.

steps.instruction: Simmer chopped {{ing:cauliflower-head}} in {{ing:milk-whole}} 12 minutes, until soft.
Drain. Blend with {{ing:butter-block}} until silky. Season.
Bake {{ing:prosciutto}} on a tray at 200C 8 minutes, until crisp.
Cut {{ing:apple-medium}} into fine matchsticks. Toss with lemon juice.
Pat {{ing:scallops}} dry. Sear in very hot {{ing:olive-oil}} 90 seconds a side.
Spoon purée on plates. Add scallops, shards of prosciutto and the apple.
Squeeze over a little {{ing:lemon}}.

swaps.text: Toasted hazelnuts, for a version with no meat

recipes.name: Twice-baked goats' cheese soufflés
recipes.method_note: Bake the day before; the second bake on the day takes 15 minutes and they rise again.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Butter six ramekins well.
Melt 40 g of {{ing:butter-block}}. Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Whisk in {{ing:milk-whole}} until thick.
Off the heat, beat in crumbled {{ing:goats-cheese}}, thyme leaves and the yolks of {{ing:egg-medium}}.
Whisk the whites stiff. Fold in gently.
Fill the ramekins. Bake in a tin of hot water 18 minutes, until risen.
Cool. Turn out into an ovenproof dish.
Pour over {{ing:double-cream}}. Grate over {{ing:parmesan}}.
Bake at 200C 15 minutes, until puffed and golden.
Serve with dressed {{ing:rocket}}.

swaps.text: Use a vegetarian hard cheese

recipes.name: Torched mackerel with beetroot and horseradish cream
recipes.method_note: Blistered skin, sharp beetroot, hot horseradish.

steps.instruction: Cut cooked {{ing:beetroot}} into wedges. Toss with {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}}.
Mix {{ing:creme-fraiche}} with {{ing:horseradish-sauce}}.
Brush {{ing:mackerel-fillet}} with {{ing:olive-oil}}. Season.
Grill skin up 3 minutes, until blistered and cooked through.
Plate with the beetroot, a spoon of the cream and {{ing:watercress}}.

swaps.text: Thick coconut yoghurt, for a dairy-free version

recipes.name: Crispy five-spice duck with plum sauce and cucumber
recipes.method_note: Duck legs slow-roasted until they shred.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 160C. Rub {{ing:duck-leg}} with {{ing:five-spice}} and {{ing:salt}}.
Roast 2 hours, until the skin is crisp and the meat soft.
Simmer chopped {{ing:plums}} with {{ing:hoisin-sauce}} and {{ing:star-anise}} 15 minutes, until jammy.
Cut {{ing:cucumber}} and {{ing:spring-onion}} into thin batons.
Shred the duck with two forks.
Warm {{ing:tortilla-wrap}}, quartered, in a dry pan.
steps.note: Or Chinese pancakes from the shop.

steps.instruction: Wrap the duck, sauce, cucumber and onion in each.

swaps.text: Little gem lettuce cups, for a gluten-free version (check the hoisin)

recipes.name: Butternut squash gnudi with brown butter and sage
recipes.method_note: Soft ricotta dumplings. Roll them gently: they are tender.

steps.instruction: Roast {{ing:butternut-squash}} 40 minutes at 200C until soft. Mash and cool.
Drain {{ing:ricotta}} in a sieve 30 minutes.
Mix ricotta, 200 g squash, {{ing:parmesan}}, {{ing:egg-yolk}}, {{ing:nutmeg}} and {{ing:flour-plain}}.
Roll into walnut-sized balls on a floured tray. Chill 20 minutes.
Simmer in salted water 3 minutes, until they float.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}} with {{ing:fresh-sage}} until nutty brown.
Spoon over the gnudi. Scatter chopped {{ing:hazelnuts}}.

swaps.text: Use a vegetarian hard cheese

recipes.name: Saffron and mozzarella arancini
recipes.method_note: Make the risotto the day before. Cold risotto shapes best.

steps.instruction: Steep {{ing:saffron}} in hot {{ing:stock-vegetable}}.
Fry chopped {{ing:shallot}} in {{ing:butter-block}}. Stir in {{ing:rice-arborio-dry}}.
Add the stock a ladle at a time, stirring, 20 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:parmesan}}. Spread on a tray. Chill overnight.
Wrap a cube of {{ing:mozzarella}} in a ball of rice.
Roll in beaten {{ing:egg-medium}}, then {{ing:panko}}.
Deep-fry in 5 cm of vegetable oil at 180C for 4 minutes, until golden.
steps.note: Nutrition counts only the oil the food soaks up.

swaps.text: Use a vegetarian hard cheese

recipes.name: Grilled oysters with kimchi butter
recipes.method_note: Spicy, buttery and smoky. A modern twist for oyster sceptics.

steps.instruction: Heat the grill to its highest.
Chop {{ing:kimchi}} finely. Mash into {{ing:butter-block}} with {{ing:gochujang}}.
Open {{ing:oysters}}. Sit them on a tray of crumpled foil so they stay level.
Top each with a teaspoon of the butter.
Grill 3 minutes, until bubbling.
Scatter sliced {{ing:spring-onion}}. Serve with wedges of {{ing:lime}}.

swaps.text: Check the label says gluten free, if you need it

recipes.name: Beetroot tartare with capers and walnut
recipes.method_note: All the shape and seasoning of steak tartare, with sweet earthy beetroot.

steps.instruction: Dice cooked {{ing:beetroot}} very finely.
Chop {{ing:shallot}}, {{ing:capers}} and {{ing:gherkins}} finely.
Mix all with {{ing:mustard-dijon}} and {{ing:olive-oil}}. Season.
Press into rings on plates. Lift off.
Top with crushed {{ing:walnuts}} and {{ing:chives}}. Add {{ing:rocket}}.

swaps.text: Toasted sunflower seeds, for a nut-free version

recipes.name: Crab thermidor pots
recipes.method_note: Rich, cheesy and bubbling. Serve with toast fingers.

steps.instruction: Heat the grill. Melt {{ing:butter-block}}. Fry chopped {{ing:shallot}} 3 minutes.
Add {{ing:wine-white}}. Boil until almost gone.
Add {{ing:double-cream}} and {{ing:mustard-dijon}}. Bubble 2 minutes.
Fold in {{ing:crab-white-meat}} and {{ing:fresh-tarragon}}.
Spoon into four small dishes. Top with grated {{ing:gruyere}} and {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}}.
Grill 4 minutes, until golden and bubbling.

swaps.text: Leave them out, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Celeriac remoulade with prosciutto and pear
recipes.method_note: A French bistro classic. Crunchy, creamy and sharp.

steps.instruction: Peel {{ing:celeriac}}. Cut into fine matchsticks.
Toss with the juice of {{ing:lemon}} straight away.
Mix {{ing:mayonnaise}}, {{ing:wholegrain-mustard}}, chopped {{ing:capers}} and {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.
Fold through the celeriac. Season.
Serve with {{ing:prosciutto}} and thin slices of {{ing:pear}}.

swaps.text: Leave it out, for a vegetarian starter

recipes.name: Salmon tartare with cucumber, dill and caviar
recipes.method_note: Sashimi-grade salmon. Keep everything cold.

steps.instruction: Skin {{ing:salmon-fillet}}. Dice into 5 mm cubes.
Mix with chopped {{ing:shallot}}, {{ing:capers}}, {{ing:fresh-dill}} and {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Add lemon zest and a squeeze of {{ing:lemon}}. Season.
Slice {{ing:cucumber}} into ribbons with a peeler.
Press the salmon into rings. Top with {{ing:caviar}}. Add the cucumber.

swaps.text: Finely chopped chives

recipes.name: Roast squash with burrata, chilli honey and sage
recipes.method_note: Hot squash, cold cream, sweet heat.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 210C. Slice {{ing:butternut-squash}} into wedges.
Toss with {{ing:olive-oil}} and {{ing:fresh-sage}}. Roast 30 minutes.
Warm {{ing:honey}} with {{ing:chilli-powder}}.
Arrange the squash on a plate. Tear {{ing:burrata}} over.
Drizzle the chilli honey. Scatter toasted {{ing:pumpkin-seeds}}.

swaps.text: Vegan feta, with maple for honey, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Classic beef Wellington with mushroom duxelles and prosciutto
recipes.method_note: The showpiece. Chill between each stage so the pastry stays crisp.

steps.instruction: Season {{ing:beef-fillet}}. Sear all over in very hot {{ing:olive-oil}}, 4 minutes.
Brush with {{ing:mustard-dijon}} while hot. Cool.
Blitz {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}} with {{ing:garlic-clove}} and thyme leaves very finely.
Fry in a dry pan 15 minutes, until a dry paste. Cool.
Overlap {{ing:prosciutto}} on cling film. Spread the duxelles over it.
Lay the beef on top. Roll up tightly in the cling film. Chill 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 200C. Unwrap onto rolled {{ing:puff-pastry}}.
Wrap the pastry round. Seal. Brush with {{ing:egg-yolk}}. Chill 15 minutes.
Score lightly. Bake 35 minutes for medium-rare.
steps.note: 50C in the middle.

steps.instruction: Rest 10 minutes before slicing thickly.

swaps.text: Thin pancakes (crêpes), the classic choice
A venison loin, baked 25 minutes

recipes.name: Rib of beef with béarnaise
recipes.method_note: A thick-cut ribeye for sharing, with the great French steak sauce.

steps.instruction: Take {{ing:beef-ribeye}} out of the fridge 1 hour before.
Simmer chopped {{ing:shallot}}, {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}} and half the tarragon until 1 tbsp is left.
Whisk the reduction with {{ing:egg-yolk}} in a bowl over simmering water until thick.
Whisk in melted {{ing:butter-unsalted}} slowly, until glossy. Add the rest of the tarragon.
steps.note: Too thick? A teaspoon of warm water loosens it.

steps.instruction: Heat a heavy pan until smoking. Add {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Sear the steaks 3 minutes a side for medium-rare.
Add {{ing:butter-block}}, crushed {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}. Spoon over 1 minute.
Rest 5 minutes. Slice. Serve with the béarnaise.

swaps.text: Green peppercorn sauce (see the beef fillet recipe)

recipes.name: Braised beef short rib with red wine and star anise
recipes.method_note: Falls off the bone. Better made the day before.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 150C.
Dust {{ing:beef-braising}} (short ribs) in {{ing:flour-plain}} and salt. Brown all over in {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Fry chopped {{ing:onion-medium}}, {{ing:carrot-medium}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}} 8 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:tomato-purée}}. Add {{ing:wine-red}}. Bubble 5 minutes.
Add {{ing:stock-chicken}}, {{ing:star-anise}}, {{ing:bay-leaf}}, {{ing:fresh-thyme}} and the ribs.
Cover. Braise 3 hours, until the meat slides off the bone.
Skim off the fat. Boil the sauce 10 minutes, until glossy.
Serve with mash or polenta.

swaps.text: Leave it out, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Pistachio-crusted rack of lamb with pomegranate jus
recipes.method_note: Pink lamb, green crust, ruby sauce.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Season {{ing:lamb-rack}} (two racks).
Sear fat side down in {{ing:olive-oil}} 4 minutes. Brown the ends.
Blitz {{ing:pistachios}}, {{ing:breadcrumbs-dried}}, {{ing:fresh-mint}} and {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.
Brush the fat with {{ing:mustard-dijon}}. Press on the crust.
Roast 18 minutes for pink.
steps.note: 55C in the middle.

steps.instruction: Rest 10 minutes.
Boil {{ing:stock-chicken}} and {{ing:pomegranate-molasses}} in the pan 4 minutes.
Carve into cutlets. Spoon over the jus and {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}}.

swaps.text: More pistachios, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Slow-cooked lamb shanks with ras el hanout, apricots and almonds
recipes.method_note: A Moroccan-style tagine. Rich and fragrant.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 160C.
Brown {{ing:lamb-shank}} all over in {{ing:olive-oil}}. Set aside.
Fry sliced {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}} 8 minutes. Stir in {{ing:ras-el-hanout}}.
Add {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}}, {{ing:stock-chicken}} and the lamb. Cover.
Braise 2 hours 30 minutes, turning once.
Add {{ing:dried-apricots}} and {{ing:honey}}. Cook 30 minutes uncovered.
Cook {{ing:couscous-dry}} with 300 ml boiling water, covered 5 minutes.
Serve with toasted {{ing:almonds}} and {{ing:fresh-coriander}}.

swaps.text: Quinoa, for a gluten-free version
Pomegranate seeds, for a nut-free version

recipes.name: Pink duck breast with cherry and port sauce
recipes.method_note: Start the duck in a cold pan so the fat renders slowly and the skin crisps.

steps.instruction: Score the skin of {{ing:duck-breast}} closely. Rub with {{ing:salt}}.
Lay skin down in a cold frying pan. Turn the heat to medium.
Cook 10 minutes, pouring off fat, until the skin is crisp.
Turn. Cook 3 minutes for pink. Rest 10 minutes.
Fry chopped {{ing:shallot}} in a spoon of the fat 2 minutes.
Add {{ing:port}}, {{ing:star-anise}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}. Boil until halved.
Add {{ing:stock-chicken}} and pitted {{ing:cherries}}. Simmer 5 minutes, until glossy.
Slice the duck. Spoon over the sauce.

swaps.text: Cherry juice with a splash of balsamic, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Venison loin with blackberry, juniper and dark chocolate sauce
recipes.method_note: A little chocolate deepens the sauce, the Italian way. Nobody will taste it as chocolate.

steps.instruction: Crush {{ing:juniper-berries}}. Rub over {{ing:venison-diced}} (a loin) with salt.
Sear in hot {{ing:olive-oil}} 2 minutes a side. Add {{ing:butter-block}}. Baste 2 minutes.
Rest 10 minutes; it carries on cooking.
Fry chopped {{ing:shallot}} in the pan. Add {{ing:wine-red}}. Boil until halved.
Add {{ing:stock-chicken}} and {{ing:redcurrant-jelly}}. Simmer 5 minutes.
Add {{ing:blackberries}}. Stir in {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}} until melted.
Slice the venison thickly. Serve with the sauce.

swaps.text: Beef fillet

recipes.name: Turbot with Champagne butter sauce and caviar
recipes.method_note: The grand old dish of special occasions.

steps.instruction: Simmer chopped {{ing:shallot}} in {{ing:sparkling-wine}} until 3 tbsp are left.
Add {{ing:double-cream}}. Bubble 2 minutes.
Off the heat, whisk in cold diced {{ing:butter-unsalted}} a piece at a time.
Season. Add a squeeze of {{ing:lemon}}. Keep warm, not hot.
Cut {{ing:turbot}} into 4. Season.
Fry in {{ing:butter-block}} 3 minutes a side, until white and flaking.
Spoon the sauce over. Top with {{ing:caviar}} and {{ing:chives}}.

swaps.text: Brill, halibut or thick cod
Any dry sparkling wine; or fish stock for no alcohol

recipes.name: Halibut with brown butter, capers and prawns
recipes.method_note: Nutty brown butter, salty capers, sweet prawns.

steps.instruction: Cut {{ing:halibut}} into 4. Season. Pat dry.
Fry in {{ing:olive-oil}} skin down 4 minutes, until golden.
Turn. Cook 2 minutes more. Lift onto plates.
Add {{ing:butter-block}} to the pan. Cook until it foams and smells nutty.
Add {{ing:capers}}, {{ing:prawns-cooked}} and the juice of {{ing:lemon}}. Warm 1 minute.
Stir in {{ing:fresh-parsley}}. Spoon over the fish.

swaps.text: Cod or hake loin

recipes.name: Lobster thermidor
recipes.method_note: The most luxurious of all. Served in the shell.

steps.instruction: Cook {{ing:lobster-tail}} in boiling salted water 5 minutes. Cool.
Split the shells. Take out the meat. Chop into chunks. Keep the shells.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}}. Fry chopped {{ing:shallot}} 3 minutes.
Add {{ing:spirit-40}} (brandy), {{ing:wine-white}} and {{ing:stock-chicken}}. Boil until halved.
Add {{ing:double-cream}} and {{ing:mustard-dijon}}. Simmer 3 minutes, until thick.
Stir in the lobster and {{ing:fresh-tarragon}}. Spoon back into the shells.
Top with grated {{ing:gruyere}}. Grill 4 minutes, until golden.

swaps.text: More stock, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Saffron bouillabaisse with rouille
recipes.method_note: A celebration fish stew from Marseille. The rouille is a garlic and saffron mayonnaise.

steps.instruction: Heat {{ing:olive-oil}}. Fry sliced {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:fennel-bulb}} 10 minutes.
Add 3 sliced {{ing:garlic-clove}}, most of the {{ing:saffron}} and a strip of {{ing:orange}} peel.
Add {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}}, {{ing:water}} and {{ing:stock-cube}}. Simmer 25 minutes.
Cut {{ing:monkfish}} and {{ing:sea-bream}} into chunks. Add. Simmer 4 minutes.
Add {{ing:king-prawns-raw}} and {{ing:mussels-cooked}}. Cook 3 minutes.
Mix {{ing:mayonnaise}} with the last garlic clove, crushed, and the rest of the saffron.
Toast {{ing:sourdough}}. Spread with rouille. Float on the stew.

swaps.text: Gluten-free bread, for a gluten-free version
Any firm white fish

recipes.name: Salmon coulibiac
recipes.method_note: A Russian centrepiece: salmon, rice, egg and dill inside golden pastry.

steps.instruction: Cook {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}}. Cool.
Hard-boil 3 of {{ing:egg-medium}} for 9 minutes. Cool. Quarter.
Fry chopped {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}} in {{ing:butter-block}} 10 minutes, until dry.
Mix rice, mushrooms, {{ing:fresh-dill}} and lemon zest. Season.
Wilt {{ing:spinach}}. Squeeze dry.
Heat the oven to 200C. Lay one sheet of {{ing:puff-pastry}} on a tray.
Layer half the rice, the spinach, {{ing:salmon-fillet}}, eggs and the rest of the rice.
Cover with the second sheet. Seal. Brush with the last egg, beaten.
Bake 40 minutes, until deep golden. Rest 10 minutes.

swaps.text: Leave them out for a simpler filling

recipes.name: Miso-glazed cod with pak choi and sesame rice
recipes.method_note: The famous restaurant dish. Marinate overnight for the deepest flavour.

steps.instruction: Warm {{ing:miso-paste}}, {{ing:mirin}}, {{ing:sake}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}} until smooth. Cool.
Coat {{ing:cod-fillet}}. Cover. Chill overnight.
Heat the grill to high. Wipe off most of the marinade.
Grill 8 minutes, until caramelised and flaking.
steps.note: Cover with foil if it darkens too fast.

steps.instruction: Cook {{ing:rice-jasmine-dry}}.
Steam halved {{ing:pak-choi}} 3 minutes. Toss with {{ing:sesame-oil}}.
Serve with {{ing:sesame-seeds}} and sliced {{ing:spring-onion}}.

swaps.text: Salmon or halibut
More mirin, for a version with less alcohol

recipes.name: Crab linguine with chilli, lemon and parsley
recipes.method_note: White and brown crab meat together gives the richest flavour.

steps.instruction: Cook {{ing:spaghetti-dry}} (linguine) in salted water for the time on the packet.
Warm {{ing:olive-oil}} with sliced {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:chilli-fresh}} 2 minutes.
Add {{ing:crab-white-meat}} and the zest and juice of {{ing:lemon}}. Warm 1 minute.
Drain the pasta, keeping a mug of water.
Toss into the crab with a splash of water and {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.
Serve with {{ing:rocket}} on top.

swaps.text: Gluten-free pasta, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Seared tuna with salsa verde and crushed potatoes
recipes.method_note: Sear hard, serve rare in the middle.

steps.instruction: Boil {{ing:potato-medium}} 18 minutes. Crush with 2 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Chop {{ing:fresh-parsley}}, {{ing:fresh-basil}}, {{ing:capers}}, {{ing:anchovy-fillet}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}}.
Mix with 3 tbsp oil and the juice of {{ing:lemon}}.
Rub {{ing:tuna-steak}} with the last oil and salt.
Sear in a smoking pan 90 seconds a side.
Slice. Serve on the potatoes with the salsa.

swaps.text: Swordfish or salmon

recipes.name: Roast pheasant breasts with mushroom and Madeira cream
recipes.method_note: Game in a rich cream sauce, the French way.

steps.instruction: Soak {{ing:shiitake-dried}} (morels or porcini) in hot water 15 minutes.
Season {{ing:pheasant}} (breasts). Fry skin down in {{ing:butter-block}} 5 minutes.
Turn. Cook 3 minutes. Rest.
Fry chopped {{ing:shallot}}, sliced {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}} and the soaked mushrooms 5 minutes.
Add {{ing:sherry}} (Madeira). Boil until halved. Add {{ing:stock-chicken}}.
Add {{ing:double-cream}}. Simmer 3 minutes. Add {{ing:fresh-tarragon}}.
Slice the pheasant. Serve with the sauce.

swaps.text: More stock and a squeeze of lemon, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Porchetta: rolled pork belly with fennel, garlic and rosemary
recipes.method_note: Crackling outside, herby and juicy inside. Dry the skin overnight in the fridge.

steps.instruction: Lay {{ing:pork-belly}} skin down. Score the flesh in a criss-cross.
Toast and crush {{ing:fennel-seeds}}. Mix with crushed {{ing:garlic-clove}}, chopped herbs and lemon zest.
Add {{ing:chilli-powder}} and half of {{ing:salt}}. Rub over the flesh.
Roll tightly. Tie with string every 3 cm. Rub the skin with the rest of the salt.
Chill uncovered overnight.
Roast at 230C for 30 minutes.
Turn to 160C. Pour {{ing:wine-white}} in the tin. Roast 2 hours 30 minutes.
Rest 20 minutes. Slice thickly.

swaps.text: Water or apple juice, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Pork fillet with prunes, Armagnac and cream
recipes.method_note: A classic from south-west France. Soak the prunes the night before.

steps.instruction: Soak {{ing:prunes}} in {{ing:spirit-40}} (Armagnac or brandy) overnight.
Cut {{ing:pork-tenderloin}} into 3 cm medallions. Season.
Fry in {{ing:butter-block}} 3 minutes a side. Set aside.
Fry chopped {{ing:shallot}} and {{ing:fresh-sage}} 3 minutes.
Add the prunes and their brandy. Let it bubble.
steps.note: Stand back: it can flame.

steps.instruction: Add {{ing:stock-chicken}}, {{ing:double-cream}} and {{ing:mustard-dijon}}. Simmer 3 minutes.
Return the pork. Warm 2 minutes, until cooked through.

swaps.text: Apple juice, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Roast chicken thighs with truffle butter and leeks
recipes.method_note: Truffle butter under the skin turns everyday chicken into a feast.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Mash {{ing:butter-block}} with {{ing:truffle-oil}}, thyme leaves and crushed {{ing:garlic-clove}}.
Spread under the skin of {{ing:chicken-thigh-boneless}}.
Slice {{ing:leek}}. Lay in a roasting tin with {{ing:wine-white}}.
Sit the chicken on top. Roast 35 minutes, until golden and cooked through.
Stir {{ing:double-cream}} into the leeks. Roast 5 minutes more.

swaps.text: Leave it out for a classic garlic butter chicken

recipes.name: Wild mushroom and truffle risotto
recipes.method_note: Porcini water in the stock gives it real depth.

steps.instruction: Soak {{ing:shiitake-dried}} (porcini) in 300 ml boiling water 20 minutes. Chop.
Add the strained soaking water to {{ing:stock-vegetable}}. Keep hot.
Fry sliced {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}} in half of {{ing:butter-block}} until golden. Set aside.
Fry chopped {{ing:shallot}}. Stir in {{ing:rice-arborio-dry}} 1 minute.
Add {{ing:wine-white}}, then the stock a ladle at a time, 20 minutes.
Stir in all the mushrooms, the rest of the butter and {{ing:parmesan}}. Rest 2 minutes.
Serve with a few drops of {{ing:truffle-oil}} and {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.

swaps.text: Use a vegetarian hard cheese

recipes.name: Whole roast celeriac with truffle, hazelnuts and brown butter
recipes.method_note: A whole celeriac, roasted for hours until tender and sweet: a vegetarian centrepiece.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Scrub {{ing:celeriac}}, leaving the skin on.
Rub with {{ing:olive-oil}} and salt. Wrap in foil with {{ing:fresh-thyme}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}}.
Roast 2 hours 30 minutes, until a knife slides in.
Unwrap. Roast 20 minutes more to brown.
Brown {{ing:butter-block}} with chopped {{ing:hazelnuts}} until nutty.
Add lemon juice and {{ing:truffle-oil}}.
Cut the celeriac into wedges. Spoon over the butter.

swaps.text: Olive oil, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Beetroot, chestnut and goats' cheese Wellington
recipes.method_note: Ruby red inside when you slice it.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Wrap {{ing:beetroot-raw}} in foil. Roast 1 hour, until tender.
Peel and slice the beetroot.
Fry sliced {{ing:red-onion}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} 10 minutes. Add {{ing:balsamic-vinegar}}.
Blanch {{ing:cavolo-nero}} 2 minutes. Squeeze dry.
Lay one sheet of {{ing:puff-pastry}} on a tray. Layer onion, greens, crumbled {{ing:chestnuts-cooked}} and thyme.
Add the beetroot and crumbled {{ing:goats-cheese}}.
Cover with the second sheet. Seal. Brush with beaten {{ing:egg-medium}}.
Bake 35 minutes, until golden. Rest 10 minutes.

swaps.text: Vegan feta, with plant milk to glaze and vegan pastry, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Charred cauliflower steaks with romesco and capers
recipes.method_note: Romesco is a smoky Spanish pepper and almond sauce.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 220C. Roast {{ing:pepper-bell}} whole 25 minutes, until blackened.
Peel and seed the peppers.
Blend with toasted {{ing:almonds}}, {{ing:garlic-clove}}, {{ing:smoked-paprika}}, {{ing:sherry}} (vinegar) and {{ing:sourdough}}.
Blend in 3 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}}. Season.
Cut each of {{ing:cauliflower-head}} into 2 thick steaks through the core.
Brush with the rest of the oil. Roast 25 minutes, turning once.
Serve on the romesco with {{ing:capers}} and {{ing:fresh-parsley}}.

swaps.text: Leave it out, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Mushroom, chestnut and spinach pithivier
recipes.method_note: A domed French pie. Score curves in the top for a sunburst pattern.

steps.instruction: Fry chopped {{ing:shallot}}, {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} 15 minutes, until dry.
Add {{ing:fresh-thyme}}, {{ing:soy-sauce}} and crumbled {{ing:chestnuts-cooked}}. Cool.
Wilt {{ing:spinach}}. Squeeze dry.
Cut a 22 cm and a 26 cm circle from {{ing:puff-pastry}}.
Dome the filling on the smaller circle, leaving a 2 cm edge. Layer spinach in the middle.
Brush the edge with {{ing:soya-milk}}. Drape the larger circle over. Press to seal.
Chill 20 minutes. Brush with soya milk. Score curves from the top.
Bake at 200C 40 minutes, until deep golden.

swaps.text: Check the label says vegan

recipes.name: Butternut, saffron and preserved lemon tagine with jewelled couscous
recipes.method_note: Golden and fragrant. Even better the next day.

steps.instruction: Fry sliced {{ing:onion-medium}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} 10 minutes. Add crushed {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:ras-el-hanout}}.
Add chunks of {{ing:butternut-squash}}, {{ing:saffron}}, {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}} and {{ing:stock-vegetable}}.
Simmer 20 minutes. Add drained {{ing:chickpeas-tinned}}, {{ing:dried-apricots}} and strips of lemon peel.
Simmer 10 minutes more.
Cover {{ing:couscous-dry}} with 350 ml boiling water. Leave 5 minutes. Fluff.
Stir {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}}, chopped {{ing:pistachios}} and lemon juice into the couscous.
Serve the tagine on the couscous.

swaps.text: Quinoa, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Aubergine parmigiana with burrata
recipes.method_note: Layers of soft aubergine and rich tomato, crowned with burrata.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Slice {{ing:aubergine}} lengthways 1 cm thick.
Brush with 4 tbsp of {{ing:olive-oil}}. Roast 25 minutes, until soft and golden.
Simmer {{ing:passata}} with sliced {{ing:garlic-clove}} and the rest of the oil 15 minutes.
Layer sauce, aubergine, torn {{ing:mozzarella}}, {{ing:fresh-basil}} and {{ing:parmesan}} in a dish.
Repeat, finishing with sauce and Parmesan.
Bake 30 minutes, until bubbling.
Tear {{ing:burrata}} over the top to serve.

swaps.text: Use a vegetarian hard cheese

recipes.name: Lobster mac and cheese
recipes.method_note: Comfort food at its most extravagant.

steps.instruction: Boil {{ing:lobster-tail}} 5 minutes. Cool. Chop the meat.
Cook {{ing:penne-dry}} 2 minutes less than the packet says. Drain.
Melt 40 g of {{ing:butter-block}}. Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Whisk in {{ing:milk-whole}} until thick.
Stir in {{ing:mustard-dijon}}, {{ing:gruyere}} and most of {{ing:cheddar-cheese}}.
Fold in the pasta and lobster. Tip into a dish.
Top with {{ing:panko}}, the rest of the cheese and butter.
Bake at 200C 20 minutes, until golden. Scatter {{ing:chives}}.

swaps.text: Crab meat or prawns

recipes.name: Sea bass with saffron mussel cream and samphire-style greens
recipes.method_note: A Michelin-style plate made simple.

steps.instruction: Simmer chopped {{ing:shallot}} and {{ing:saffron}} in {{ing:wine-white}} until halved.
Add {{ing:double-cream}}. Simmer 3 minutes. Add {{ing:mussels-cooked}}. Keep warm.
Boil {{ing:green-beans}} 3 minutes. Toss with {{ing:butter-block}} and lemon.
Score the skin of {{ing:sea-bass-fillet}}. Season.
Fry skin down in {{ing:olive-oil}} 3 minutes, pressing flat. Turn for 30 seconds.
Spoon the mussel cream into bowls. Add the beans and fish.

swaps.text: Bream, hake or cod

recipes.name: Venison, port and chestnut pie
recipes.method_note: A rich game pie under a golden lid. Make the filling a day ahead.

steps.instruction: Toss {{ing:venison-diced}} in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Brown in batches in {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Fry chopped {{ing:bacon-streaky-raw}}, {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:carrot-medium}} 8 minutes.
Add {{ing:wine-red}}, {{ing:port}}, {{ing:stock-chicken}}, crushed {{ing:juniper-berries}} and the meat.
Cover. Simmer gently 2 hours, until tender.
Stir in {{ing:chestnuts-cooked}}. Cool completely.
Heat the oven to 200C. Spoon into a pie dish. Cover with {{ing:puff-pastry}}.
Brush with beaten {{ing:egg-medium}}. Bake 35 minutes, until golden.

swaps.text: Beef braising steak

recipes.name: Roast hake with chorizo, butter beans and saffron
recipes.method_note: Spanish flavours, one pan.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Fry sliced {{ing:chorizo}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} in an ovenproof pan 3 minutes.
Add sliced {{ing:garlic-clove}}, {{ing:saffron}} and halved {{ing:cherry-tomato}}. Cook 3 minutes.
Add drained {{ing:butter-beans-tinned}} and {{ing:stock-chicken}}. Simmer 5 minutes.
Sit {{ing:hake-fillet}} pieces on top. Roast 10 minutes, until flaking.
Scatter {{ing:fresh-parsley}}. Serve with wedges of {{ing:lemon}}.

swaps.text: Smoked paprika and more oil, for a fish-only dish

recipes.name: Scallop and lemon risotto with crisp prosciutto
recipes.method_note: Creamy risotto, sweet scallops seared at the last moment.

steps.instruction: Bake {{ing:prosciutto}} at 200C 8 minutes, until crisp.
Fry chopped {{ing:shallot}} in half of {{ing:butter-block}}. Stir in {{ing:rice-arborio-dry}}.
Add {{ing:wine-white}}, then hot {{ing:stock-chicken}} a ladle at a time, 18 minutes.
Add {{ing:peas-frozen}}. Cook 2 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:parmesan}}, the rest of the butter and the zest of {{ing:lemon}}.
Sear {{ing:scallops}} in very hot {{ing:olive-oil}} 90 seconds a side.
Serve on the risotto with shards of prosciutto.

swaps.text: Leave it out, for a fish-only dish

recipes.name: Beef bourguignon with lardons and glazed shallots
recipes.method_note: The French classic. Slow, deep and better the next day.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 150C.
Cut {{ing:beef-braising}} into large chunks. Toss in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Brown in batches in {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Fry {{ing:pancetta}} until golden. Add peeled {{ing:shallot}}. Brown 5 minutes.
Add {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:tomato-purée}}. Pour in {{ing:wine-red}}.
Add {{ing:stock-chicken}}, {{ing:fresh-thyme}}, {{ing:bay-leaf}} and the beef. Cover.
Braise 3 hours.
Add browned {{ing:mushroom-chestnut}}. Cook 30 minutes more.
Season. Serve with buttery mash.

swaps.text: Cornflour, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Roast quail with pears, bacon and sage
recipes.method_note: Two little birds each, with pear roasted alongside.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 220C.
Tuck a leaf of {{ing:fresh-sage}} inside each of {{ing:quail}}. Wrap with {{ing:bacon-streaky-raw}}.
Quarter {{ing:pear}}. Toss with {{ing:olive-oil}} in a roasting tin.
Sit the quail on top. Roast 15 minutes, until golden and cooked.
Rest 5 minutes.
Add {{ing:cider-dry}} and {{ing:redcurrant-jelly}} to the tin. Bubble 3 minutes on the hob.
Serve the quail and pears with the sauce.

swaps.text: Apple juice, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Whole salmon fillet with miso, ginger and spring onion
recipes.method_note: Big, glossy and impressive, ready in 25 minutes.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Line a tray. Lay {{ing:salmon-fillet}} skin down.
Mix {{ing:miso-paste}}, {{ing:honey}}, {{ing:soy-sauce}}, grated {{ing:ginger-fresh}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}}.
Spread over the salmon.
Bake 20 minutes, until it flakes in the middle.
Scatter sliced {{ing:spring-onion}}, {{ing:chilli-fresh}} and {{ing:sesame-seeds}}.
Squeeze over {{ing:lime}}.

swaps.text: Tamari and a miso labelled gluten free, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Crispy five-spice pork belly with plum sauce
recipes.method_note: Crackling like glass. Chinese roast pork at home.

steps.instruction: Rub {{ing:five-spice}} into the meat side of {{ing:pork-belly}}. Not the skin.
Dry the skin. Brush with {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}}. Pack on {{ing:salt}}. Chill overnight uncovered.
Brush off the salt. Roast at 160C for 1 hour 30 minutes.
Turn up to 240C. Roast 20 minutes, until the skin crackles.
Simmer chopped {{ing:plums}}, {{ing:hoisin-sauce}}, {{ing:star-anise}} and {{ing:ginger-fresh}} 15 minutes.
Cook {{ing:rice-jasmine-dry}}. Steam {{ing:pak-choi}} 3 minutes.
Chop the pork into chunks. Serve with the sauce, rice and greens.

swaps.text: Check the label says gluten free, if you need it

recipes.name: Turkey breast ballotine with pistachio and cranberry stuffing
recipes.method_note: A boneless turkey roll that carves into perfect slices. Ideal for smaller tables.

steps.instruction: Butterfly {{ing:turkey-crown}} (boneless breast) and bash it to 2 cm thick between cling film.
Mix {{ing:sausagemeat}}, chopped {{ing:pistachios}}, {{ing:dried-cranberries}}, {{ing:fresh-sage}} and orange zest.
Spread over the turkey. Roll up tightly.
Wrap in overlapping {{ing:prosciutto}}. Tie with string.
Heat the oven to 190C. Brush with {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Roast 1 hour 15 minutes, until 75C in the middle.
Rest 15 minutes. Slice thickly.

swaps.text: Gluten-free sausages, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Sesame tofu with Japanese katsu curry sauce
recipes.method_note: Crisp, golden tofu with a mild, sweet curry sauce.

steps.instruction: Fry chopped {{ing:onion-medium}} and {{ing:carrot-medium}} in 1 tbsp of {{ing:vegetable-oil}} 8 minutes.
Stir in {{ing:curry-powder}}. Add {{ing:stock-vegetable}}, {{ing:soy-sauce}} and {{ing:maple-syrup}}. Simmer 15 minutes.
Blend smooth. Thicken with 1 tbsp of the cornflour in water.
Cook {{ing:rice-jasmine-dry}}.
Slice {{ing:tofu-firm}} into 4 slabs. Pat dry.
Coat in the rest of {{ing:cornflour}} mixed with water, then {{ing:panko}} and {{ing:sesame-seeds}}.
Fry in the rest of the oil 3 minutes a side, until golden.
Slice. Serve over rice with the sauce.

swaps.text: Tamari and gluten-free crumbs, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Gnocchi with blue cheese, pear and walnuts
recipes.method_note: Rich and quick, ready in 15 minutes.

steps.instruction: Bake {{ing:potato-large}} at 200C 1 hour. Scoop out and mash smooth while hot.
Mix with {{ing:flour-plain}}, {{ing:egg-yolk}} and salt into a soft dough.
Roll into ropes. Cut into 2 cm pieces.
Boil in salted water until they float, 2 minutes.
Fry {{ing:fresh-sage}} in {{ing:butter-block}}. Add {{ing:double-cream}} and crumbled {{ing:stilton}}.
Toss in the gnocchi and diced {{ing:pear}}. Scatter toasted {{ing:walnuts}}.

swaps.text: 500 g shop-bought gnocchi

recipes.name: Hot chocolate and orange soufflés
recipes.method_note: Have everyone seated before they go in: soufflés wait for nobody.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C with a tray inside. Butter six ramekins. Dust with sugar.
Melt {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}} with {{ing:double-cream}}. Stir in orange zest and {{ing:orange-liqueur}}.
Beat in the yolks of {{ing:egg-medium}}.
Whisk the whites stiff. Whisk in {{ing:sugar-caster}} a spoonful at a time.
Fold a third into the chocolate, then the rest gently.
Fill the ramekins. Run a thumb round the rims.
steps.note: This helps them rise straight.

steps.instruction: Bake on the hot tray 10 minutes, until risen.
Dust with {{ing:icing-sugar}}. Serve at once.

swaps.text: More orange zest, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Salted caramel and dark chocolate tart
recipes.method_note: Thin slices: it is very rich. Make the day before.

steps.instruction: Line a 23 cm tart tin with {{ing:shortcrust-pastry}}. Bake blind at 190C 25 minutes.
Cool. Stir {{ing:salt}} (flaky sea salt) into {{ing:dulce-de-leche}}. Spread over the base.
Chill 20 minutes.
Heat {{ing:double-cream}} until steaming. Pour over chopped {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}}.
Stir until glossy. Stir in {{ing:butter-block}}.
Pour over the caramel. Chill 3 hours, until set.
Dust the edge with {{ing:cocoa-powder}}. Add a pinch of sea salt.

swaps.text: A biscuit base of crushed digestives and butter

recipes.name: Poached pear and almond frangipane tart
recipes.method_note: A French patisserie classic.

steps.instruction: Simmer peeled, halved {{ing:pear}} in {{ing:apple-juice}}, 100 g of the sugar and {{ing:vanilla-extract}} 15 minutes.
Line a 23 cm tin with {{ing:shortcrust-pastry}}. Bake blind at 190C 20 minutes.
Beat {{ing:butter-block}} with the rest of {{ing:sugar-caster}}. Beat in {{ing:egg-medium}}.
Fold in {{ing:ground-almonds}} and {{ing:flour-plain}}.
Spread in the case. Press in the pears, sliced and fanned.
Bake at 180C 35 minutes, until golden and set.
Brush with the boiled-down poaching syrup.

swaps.text: Gluten-free versions, for a gluten-free tart

recipes.name: Vanilla crème brûlée
recipes.method_note: Bake gently in a water bath for a silky set. Caramelise just before serving.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 150C. Sit six ramekins in a roasting tin.
Heat {{ing:double-cream}} and {{ing:vanilla-extract}} until steaming.
Whisk {{ing:egg-yolk}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}}. Pour on the cream, whisking.
Strain into the ramekins. Pour hot water halfway up the tin.
Bake 30 minutes, until set with a wobble.
Cool. Chill at least 4 hours.
Sprinkle each with {{ing:sugar-demerara}}. Melt with a blowtorch or under a very hot grill.

swaps.text: Seeds of a vanilla pod
Add orange zest or a pinch of cardamom to the cream

recipes.name: Passion fruit and mango pavlova
recipes.method_note: Bright and tropical, a lift after a rich main.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 140C. Whisk {{ing:egg-white}} stiff.
Whisk in {{ing:sugar-caster}} a spoonful at a time until glossy.
Fold in {{ing:cornflour}} and {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}}. Spread a 22 cm circle on baking paper.
Turn to 120C. Bake 1 hour 15 minutes. Cool in the oven.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}} with lime zest.
Pile on the meringue. Top with diced {{ing:mango}}.
Spoon over the pulp of {{ing:passion-fruit}}.

swaps.text: Coconut yoghurt, for a dairy-free version

recipes.name: Port-roasted figs with vanilla mascarpone and hazelnut brittle
recipes.method_note: Jammy figs, cool cream, a shard of crunch.

steps.instruction: Melt {{ing:sugar-caster}} in a pan until amber. Stir in {{ing:hazelnuts}}.
steps.note: Molten sugar is very hot. Do not touch.

steps.instruction: Tip onto baking paper. Cool. Break into shards.
Heat the oven to 200C. Halve {{ing:figs-fresh}}. Lay in a dish.
Pour over {{ing:port}} and {{ing:honey}}. Roast 12 minutes.
Beat {{ing:mascarpone}} with {{ing:vanilla-extract}} and {{ing:icing-sugar}}.
Serve the figs and syrup with the mascarpone and brittle.

swaps.text: Pomegranate juice, for no alcohol

recipes.name: White chocolate and raspberry cheesecake
recipes.method_note: No baking. Set overnight in the fridge.

steps.instruction: Crush {{ing:digestive-biscuit}}. Mix with melted {{ing:butter-block}}. Press into a 23 cm tin.
Melt {{ing:white-chocolate}} gently. Cool 5 minutes.
steps.note: White chocolate burns easily; use a low heat.

steps.instruction: Beat {{ing:cream-cheese}}, {{ing:icing-sugar}} and {{ing:vanilla-extract}}. Beat in the chocolate.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}} to soft peaks. Fold in.
Ripple through half of {{ing:raspberries}}, crushed. Spread over the base.
Chill overnight. Top with the rest of the raspberries.

swaps.text: Gluten-free biscuits, for a gluten-free base

recipes.name: Upside-down pear and ginger pudding
recipes.method_note: Caramel pears on a dark, sticky ginger sponge.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Line a 23 cm cake tin.
Melt 30 g of {{ing:butter-block}} and 30 g of {{ing:sugar-muscovado}} in the tin base.
Slice {{ing:pear}}. Arrange on the caramel.
Melt the rest of the butter and sugar with {{ing:golden-syrup}} and {{ing:black-treacle}}.
Stir in {{ing:flour-self-raising}}, {{ing:ginger-ground}}, {{ing:egg-medium}}, {{ing:milk-whole}} and chopped {{ing:stem-ginger}}.
Pour over the pears. Bake 40 minutes, until springy.
Turn out while warm. Serve with cream or custard.

swaps.text: Dairy-free spread and oat milk, for a dairy-free version

recipes.name: Rhubarb and custard trifle with ginger
recipes.method_note: Forced pink rhubarb arrives in late December. Sharp, sweet and pretty.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Cut {{ing:rhubarb}} into 4 cm lengths.
Toss with {{ing:sugar-caster}} and orange juice. Roast 15 minutes, until tender. Cool.
Break {{ing:ginger-nut-biscuits}} into a glass bowl. Spoon over the rhubarb juices.
Layer in the rhubarb, then {{ing:custard-ready}}.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}} softly. Spread on top.
Scatter chopped {{ing:stem-ginger}}. Chill 2 hours.

swaps.text: Sponge fingers

recipes.name: Triple chocolate mousse cake
recipes.method_note: Dark, milk and white layers. A party showstopper.

steps.instruction: Crush {{ing:digestive-biscuit}}. Mix with melted {{ing:butter-block}}. Press into a 23 cm springform tin.
Melt {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}}. Fold into 300 ml of softly whipped {{ing:double-cream}}.
Spread over the base. Freeze 20 minutes.
Repeat with {{ing:milk-chocolate-bar}} and 300 ml whipped cream. Freeze 20 minutes.
Repeat with {{ing:white-chocolate}} and the last cream.
Chill 4 hours. Dust with {{ing:cocoa-powder}}.

swaps.text: Gluten-free biscuits, for a gluten-free cake

recipes.name: Cardamom and rose panna cotta with pistachio
recipes.method_note: Set with cornflour and coconut, so it is vegan and wobbles beautifully.

steps.instruction: Crush {{ing:cardamom}}. Heat with {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}}, {{ing:oat-cream}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}}. Leave 15 minutes.
Strain. Whisk in {{ing:cornflour}} mixed with 3 tbsp cold water.
Stir on a low heat 4 minutes, until thick.
Stir in {{ing:rose-water}}. Pour into 6 small glasses.
Chill 4 hours, until set.
Top with chopped {{ing:pistachios}} and {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}}.

swaps.text: Leave them out, for a nut-free version

recipes.name: Apple tarte tatin with Calvados cream
recipes.method_note: Deep amber caramel is the goal. Do not stir; swirl the pan.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C.
Melt {{ing:sugar-caster}} in a 24 cm ovenproof pan until deep amber.
steps.note: Swirl, do not stir. Molten sugar is very hot.

steps.instruction: Stir in {{ing:butter-block}}. Take off the heat.
Peel and halve {{ing:apple-medium}}. Pack in tightly, rounded side down.
Cook on a medium heat 10 minutes.
Cover with {{ing:puff-pastry}}. Tuck in the edges. Bake 25 minutes.
Rest 5 minutes. Turn out onto a plate, using oven gloves.
Stir {{ing:spirit-40}} (Calvados or brandy) into {{ing:creme-fraiche}}. Serve alongside.

swaps.text: Leave it out, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Mont Blanc: chestnut cream on meringue
recipes.method_note: A French and Italian Christmas classic. Snowy peaks of chestnut.

steps.instruction: Whisk {{ing:egg-white}} stiff. Whisk in {{ing:sugar-caster}}. Pipe six discs.
Bake at 110C 1 hour 30 minutes. Cool.
Simmer {{ing:chestnuts-cooked}} in {{ing:milk-whole}} 5 minutes. Blend with {{ing:icing-sugar}}.
Add {{ing:vanilla-extract}} and {{ing:spirit-40}} (rum). Push through a sieve. Cool.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}}. Spoon onto each meringue.
Pipe the chestnut over in thin strands, like spaghetti.
Grate over {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}}.

swaps.text: Leave it out, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Clementine baked Alaska
recipes.method_note: Hot meringue, frozen middle. Assemble ahead and freeze; brown at the last minute.

steps.instruction: Cut {{ing:panettone}} into a 20 cm round, 2 cm thick. Sit on a tray.
Sprinkle with {{ing:orange-liqueur}}. Top with sliced {{ing:clementine}}.
Dome softened {{ing:ice-cream-vanilla}} on top. Freeze 2 hours, until solid.
Whisk {{ing:egg-white}} stiff. Whisk in {{ing:sugar-caster}} until thick and glossy.
Heat the oven to 230C. Spread the meringue over, sealing it to the cake.
steps.note: Any gap lets the heat in and melts the ice cream.

steps.instruction: Bake 4 minutes, until browned at the tips.
Serve at once.

swaps.text: Orange juice, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Chocolate pots de crème with salted caramel
recipes.method_note: Silky little custards with a hidden caramel layer.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 150C. Stir {{ing:salt}} into {{ing:dulce-de-leche}}. Spoon into six small pots.
Heat {{ing:double-cream}} and {{ing:milk-whole}}. Pour over chopped {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}}. Stir smooth.
Whisk {{ing:egg-yolk}} with {{ing:sugar-caster}}. Whisk in the chocolate.
Pour gently over the caramel.
Bake in a tin of hot water 25 minutes, until set at the edges.
Chill 3 hours.

swaps.text: Leave it out for plain chocolate pots

recipes.name: Blood orange, olive oil and almond cake
recipes.method_note: Moist, fragrant and naturally gluten free.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 170C. Line a 23 cm tin.
Whisk {{ing:olive-oil}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}} and {{ing:egg-medium}} until pale.
Add the zest and juice of one {{ing:grapefruit}} (blood orange).
Fold in {{ing:ground-almonds}}, {{ing:cornflour}} and {{ing:baking-powder}}.
Bake 45 minutes, until a skewer comes out clean.
Mix {{ing:icing-sugar}} with juice from the second orange. Drizzle over.
Top with slices of the orange.

swaps.text: Ordinary oranges or clementines
