recipes.name: Lychee, lime and ginger granita
recipes.method_note: Icy and refreshing after a feast.

steps.instruction: Simmer {{ing:water}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}} and sliced {{ing:ginger-fresh}} 5 minutes. Cool.
Blend {{ing:lychees}} with the syrup and the juice of {{ing:lime}}. Strain.
Pour into a shallow tray. Freeze 1 hour.
Scrape with a fork. Freeze again. Repeat every 30 minutes, 3 times.
Spoon into chilled glasses.

swaps.text: Mango or pineapple

recipes.name: Luxury black forest trifle
recipes.method_note: Chocolate sponge, kirsch cherries, rich custard and cream.

steps.instruction: Simmer {{ing:cherries}} with {{ing:sugar-caster}} 5 minutes. Add {{ing:spirit-40}} (kirsch). Cool.
Cube {{ing:brioche}}. Layer in a glass bowl. Spoon over the cherry juice.
Add the cherries.
Melt {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}}. Stir into {{ing:custard-ready}}. Pour over.
Chill 1 hour.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}} with {{ing:vanilla-extract}}. Spread on top.
Dust with {{ing:cocoa-powder}}.

swaps.text: Cherry juice, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Vegan espresso and chocolate silk tart
recipes.method_note: A no-bake tart that tastes like a mocha. Nobody will guess.

steps.instruction: Blitz {{ing:oats-rolled}}, {{ing:dates-pitted}}, {{ing:almonds}} and 1 tbsp of {{ing:cocoa-powder}}.
Press into a 22 cm tin. Chill.
Melt {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}}. Dissolve {{ing:coffee-instant}} in 1 tbsp hot water.
Blend {{ing:tofu-silken}}, the chocolate, coffee and {{ing:maple-syrup}} until silky.
Pour into the case. Chill 4 hours, until set.
Dust with the rest of the cocoa.

swaps.text: Oats labelled gluten free, for a gluten-free tart

recipes.name: Honey-poached quince with vanilla and crème fraîche
recipes.method_note: Slow poaching turns pale quince a deep, glowing pink.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 150C. Peel, quarter and core {{ing:quince}}.
Lay in a dish with {{ing:honey}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}}, {{ing:cinnamon-stick}} and {{ing:vanilla-extract}}.
Add the juice of {{ing:lemon}} and water to cover.
Cover with foil. Bake 3 hours, until soft and pink.
Serve warm with {{ing:creme-fraiche}} and chopped {{ing:pistachios}}.

swaps.text: Maple syrup, with coconut yoghurt, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Salted caramel and hazelnut brownies
recipes.method_note: Fudgy, gooey and deeply chocolatey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 180C. Line a 20 x 30 cm tin.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}} with {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}}.
Whisk {{ing:egg-medium}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}} until thick. Fold in the chocolate.
Sift in {{ing:flour-plain}} and {{ing:cocoa-powder}}. Fold. Add toasted {{ing:hazelnuts}}.
Spread in the tin. Dot with {{ing:dulce-de-leche}}. Swirl. Sprinkle {{ing:salt}}.
Bake 25 minutes, until barely set in the middle.
steps.note: They firm up as they cool.

steps.instruction: Cool in the tin. Cut into 12.

swaps.text: Ground almonds, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Espresso martini tiramisu
recipes.method_note: The cocktail as a pudding: coffee, vodka and coffee liqueur.

steps.instruction: Dissolve {{ing:coffee-instant}} in 300 ml boiling water. Cool. Add {{ing:spirit-40}} (vodka) and {{ing:orange-liqueur}} (coffee liqueur).
Whisk {{ing:mascarpone}}, {{ing:double-cream}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}} and {{ing:vanilla-extract}} until thick.
Dip half of {{ing:sponge-fingers}} briefly in the coffee. Lay in a dish.
Spread with half the cream. Repeat.
Chill 6 hours.
Dust with {{ing:cocoa-powder}}.

swaps.text: More coffee, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Spiced plum and almond galette
recipes.method_note: A rustic open tart. Rough edges are the charm.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Roll {{ing:shortcrust-pastry}} into a 30 cm circle on a lined tray.
Mix {{ing:ground-almonds}} with half the sugar. Spread over the middle.
Halve and stone {{ing:plums}}. Pile on top, leaving a 5 cm edge.
Dust with {{ing:cinnamon-ground}} and ground {{ing:star-anise}}.
Fold the edge over the fruit. Brush with beaten {{ing:egg-medium}}. Sprinkle the rest of {{ing:sugar-demerara}}.
Bake 40 minutes, until golden and bubbling.
Serve warm with {{ing:creme-fraiche}}.

swaps.text: Gluten-free shortcrust, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Mango sticky rice with coconut and lime
recipes.method_note: The Thai street classic. Salty-sweet coconut sauce is the magic.

steps.instruction: Cook {{ing:rice-jasmine-dry}} until soft and sticky.
Warm {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}} with {{ing:sugar-caster}} and {{ing:salt}} until dissolved.
Stir two thirds into the hot rice. Cover. Leave 20 minutes.
Slice {{ing:mango}}.
Spoon the rice onto plates. Add the mango. Pour over the rest of the coconut.
Scatter {{ing:sesame-seeds}}. Add lime zest.

swaps.text: Glutinous (sticky) rice, soaked overnight, for the traditional version

recipes.name: Cherry and almond clafoutis
recipes.method_note: A French batter pudding, puffed and golden.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 190C. Butter a dish with {{ing:butter-block}}. Scatter in {{ing:cherries}}.
Whisk {{ing:egg-medium}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}}. Whisk in {{ing:flour-plain}} and {{ing:ground-almonds}}.
Whisk in {{ing:milk-whole}} and {{ing:orange-liqueur}} (amaretto) until smooth.
Pour over the cherries.
Bake 35 minutes, until puffed and golden.
Dust with {{ing:icing-sugar}}. Serve warm.

swaps.text: A drop of almond extract, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Prosecco and raspberry jellies
recipes.method_note: Set softly with cornflour, so they are vegan. Soft, glistening and boozy.

steps.instruction: Heat {{ing:cranberry-juice}} with {{ing:sugar-caster}}.
Whisk in {{ing:cornflour}} mixed with 4 tbsp cold water. Stir 3 minutes, until thick and clear.
Cool 10 minutes. Stir in {{ing:sparkling-wine}} gently.
Divide {{ing:raspberries}} between 6 glasses. Pour over.
Chill 4 hours, until set.
Top with {{ing:fresh-mint}}.

swaps.text: Sparkling grape juice, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Saffron, honey and pistachio ice cream (no churn)
recipes.method_note: Inspired by Persian bastani. No machine needed.

steps.instruction: Steep {{ing:saffron}} in 1 tbsp hot water 10 minutes.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}} to soft peaks.
Fold in {{ing:condensed-milk}}, the saffron, {{ing:rose-water}} and {{ing:honey}}.
Fold in chopped {{ing:pistachios}}.
Freeze in a tub 6 hours, until firm.
Soften 10 minutes before scooping.

swaps.text: Leave them out, for a nut-free version

recipes.name: Persimmon, pomegranate and mint salad with orange blossom
recipes.method_note: Light and jewel-bright.

steps.instruction: Slice {{ing:persimmon}} into thin wedges.
Arrange on a plate with segments of {{ing:orange}}.
Mix {{ing:maple-syrup}} and {{ing:rose-water}} (orange blossom water). Drizzle over.
Scatter {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}}, {{ing:fresh-mint}} and chopped {{ing:pistachios}}.

swaps.text: Mango or ripe pear

recipes.name: Chocolate fondue with fruit and brioche
recipes.method_note: Something to share by the fire.

steps.instruction: Heat {{ing:double-cream}} until steaming. Pour over chopped {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}}.
Stir until glossy. Stir in {{ing:orange-liqueur}}.
Keep warm over a candle or a pan of hot water.
Cut {{ing:strawberries}}, {{ing:clementine}}, {{ing:banana-medium}} and toasted {{ing:brioche}} into bite-sized pieces.
Serve with forks for dipping.

swaps.text: Coconut cream, with vegan chocolate, for a vegan fondue

recipes.name: Panettone and marsala semifreddo
recipes.method_note: A frozen Italian cream with chunks of panettone. Make up to a week ahead.

steps.instruction: Line a 900 g loaf tin with cling film.
Whisk {{ing:egg-medium}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}} and {{ing:sherry}} (Marsala) over simmering water 8 minutes, until thick.
steps.note: It should reach 71C, so the eggs are cooked.

steps.instruction: Whisk off the heat until cool.
Whip {{ing:double-cream}} to soft peaks. Fold in.
Fold in cubes of {{ing:panettone}}, chopped {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}} and {{ing:pistachios}}.
Pour into the tin. Freeze overnight.
Turn out. Slice with a hot knife.

swaps.text: Orange juice, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Pink grapefruit and rosemary sorbet
recipes.method_note: A palate cleanser between courses, or a light finish.

steps.instruction: Simmer {{ing:water}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}} and {{ing:fresh-rosemary}} 5 minutes. Cool. Remove the rosemary.
Squeeze {{ing:grapefruit}} and {{ing:lemon}}. Mix with the syrup.
Freeze in a tray, scraping and stirring every hour, 4 times.
Blend briefly before serving for a smooth texture.

swaps.text: Blood oranges

recipes.name: Profiteroles with praline cream and hot chocolate sauce
recipes.method_note: Choux pastry is easier than it looks. Dry them well so they stay crisp.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Bring {{ing:butter-block}} and 200 ml water to the boil.
Tip in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Beat until it leaves the pan. Cool 5 minutes.
Beat in {{ing:egg-medium}} one at a time, until glossy.
Pipe 24 small balls. Bake 25 minutes, until crisp. Pierce each.
Caramelise {{ing:sugar-caster}} with {{ing:hazelnuts}}. Cool. Blitz to crumbs.
steps.note: Molten sugar is very hot.

steps.instruction: Whip 300 ml of {{ing:double-cream}}. Fold in the praline. Pipe into the buns.
Melt {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}} with the rest of the cream. Pour over to serve.

swaps.text: Plain whipped cream with vanilla

recipes.name: Truffle and Parmesan mash
recipes.method_note: Rich enough for the main event.

steps.instruction: Peel and chunk {{ing:potato-large}}. Boil 15 minutes, until soft.
Drain. Steam dry 2 minutes. Push through a ricer or mash.
Beat in {{ing:butter-block}}, warm {{ing:double-cream}} and {{ing:parmesan}}.
Season. Drizzle {{ing:truffle-oil}} to serve.

swaps.text: Use a vegetarian hard cheese

recipes.name: Duck fat roast potatoes with garlic and rosemary
recipes.method_note: The crispest roast potatoes there are.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 220C. Melt {{ing:duck-fat}} in a roasting tin in the oven.
Peel and chunk {{ing:potato-large}}. Boil 8 minutes. Drain. Shake to rough up.
Tip into the hot fat. Roast 30 minutes.
Turn. Add {{ing:fresh-rosemary}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}}. Roast 25 minutes.
Sprinkle with {{ing:salt}}.

swaps.text: Vegetable oil, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Pommes Anna
recipes.method_note: A golden cake of thin potato slices and butter.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 220C.
Peel {{ing:potato-large}}. Slice 2 mm thin. Do not rinse.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}}. Brush a 22 cm ovenproof pan.
Layer the slices in overlapping circles, brushing with butter and adding thyme and salt.
Press down. Cook on the hob 5 minutes.
Bake 45 minutes, until tender and golden underneath.
Turn out onto a board. Cut into wedges.

swaps.text: Olive oil, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Shredded sprouts with brown butter, hazelnuts and lemon
recipes.method_note: Fast, bright and nutty.

steps.instruction: Shred {{ing:brussels-sprouts}} finely.
Brown {{ing:butter-block}} with chopped {{ing:hazelnuts}} until nutty.
Add the sprouts. Toss 4 minutes, until bright and tender-crisp.
Add lemon zest and juice. Season. Grate over {{ing:parmesan}}.

swaps.text: Olive oil and no cheese, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Honey-roast heritage beetroot and carrots with dukkah
recipes.method_note: Colourful and crunchy.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Cut {{ing:beetroot-raw}} and {{ing:carrot-medium}} into wedges.
Toss with {{ing:olive-oil}}. Roast 35 minutes.
Drizzle {{ing:honey}}. Roast 10 minutes more.
Toast and crush {{ing:hazelnuts}}, {{ing:sesame-seeds}}, {{ing:cumin-ground}} and {{ing:coriander-ground}}.
Scatter the dukkah over the vegetables.

swaps.text: Maple syrup, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Celeriac and potato gratin with Gruyère
recipes.method_note: Creamy, cheesy and earthy.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 170C.
Peel and thinly slice {{ing:celeriac}} and {{ing:potato-large}}.
Warm {{ing:double-cream}} and {{ing:milk-whole}} with {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:nutmeg}}.
Layer the slices in a dish, seasoning. Pour over the cream.
Top with grated {{ing:gruyere}}. Bake 1 hour 20 minutes.

swaps.text: Use a vegetarian alpine-style cheese

recipes.name: Glazed chestnuts and shallots with thyme
recipes.method_note: A sweet, glossy side for turkey or nut roast.

steps.instruction: Peel {{ing:shallot}}. Fry in {{ing:olive-oil}} 10 minutes, until golden.
Add {{ing:chestnuts-cooked}}, {{ing:maple-syrup}}, {{ing:balsamic-vinegar}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}.
Cook 5 minutes, tossing, until glazed.

recipes.name: Red cabbage with port, orange and juniper
recipes.method_note: A richer, spicier red cabbage.

steps.instruction: Fry sliced {{ing:red-onion}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} 5 minutes.
Add shredded {{ing:red-cabbage}}, {{ing:port}}, the zest and juice of {{ing:orange}} and {{ing:sugar-muscovado}}.
Add crushed {{ing:juniper-berries}}, {{ing:cinnamon-stick}} and {{ing:balsamic-vinegar}}.
Cover. Cook on a low heat 1 hour.

swaps.text: Red grape juice, for no alcohol (check port is labelled vegan)

recipes.name: Silky parsnip and vanilla purée
recipes.method_note: A touch of vanilla brings out parsnip's sweetness. Lovely with game.

steps.instruction: Peel and chop {{ing:parsnip}}.
Simmer in {{ing:milk-whole}} 15 minutes, until soft.
Drain, keeping the milk. Blend with {{ing:butter-block}}, {{ing:vanilla-extract}} and {{ing:nutmeg}}.
Add milk until silky. Season.

swaps.text: Oat milk and olive oil, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Wild rice, chestnut and cranberry pilaf
recipes.method_note: A festive rice side, or a stuffing for vegans.

steps.instruction: Cook {{ing:wild-rice}} 40 minutes. Add {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}} for the last 12 minutes.
Fry chopped {{ing:onion-medium}} in {{ing:olive-oil}} 8 minutes.
Drain the rice. Mix with onion, crumbled {{ing:chestnuts-cooked}} and {{ing:dried-cranberries}}.
Add {{ing:fresh-parsley}} and orange zest. Season.

recipes.name: Classic Champagne cocktail
recipes.method_note: A sugar cube, bitters, brandy and fizz: the 1920s glamour drink.

steps.instruction: Put a teaspoon of {{ing:sugar-demerara}} (or a sugar cube) in each flute.
Add a few drops of bitters, if you have them.
Add 15 ml of {{ing:spirit-40}} (cognac) to each.
Top up slowly with {{ing:sparkling-wine}}.
Twist a strip of {{ing:orange}} peel over each.

swaps.text: Sparkling grape juice, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Pomegranate and orange winter spritz
recipes.method_note: Bittersweet, ruby red and festive.

steps.instruction: Fill four wine glasses with ice.
Add 50 ml of {{ing:pomegranate-juice}} and 15 ml of {{ing:orange-liqueur}} to each.
Top up with {{ing:sparkling-wine}}.
Add a slice of {{ing:orange}} and a few {{ing:pomegranate-seeds}}.

swaps.text: Use soda water and no liqueur

recipes.name: Gingerbread white Russian
recipes.method_note: Creamy, spiced and very festive.

steps.instruction: Fill two tumblers with ice.
Add 30 ml of {{ing:spirit-40}} (vodka) and 20 ml of {{ing:orange-liqueur}} (coffee liqueur) to each.
Whisk {{ing:double-cream}}, {{ing:golden-syrup}} and {{ing:ginger-ground}}. Float on top.
Crumble over {{ing:ginger-nut-biscuits}}.

swaps.text: Cold coffee instead of vodka and liqueur

recipes.name: Hot buttered rum
recipes.method_note: A warming fireside drink.

steps.instruction: Mash {{ing:butter-block}} with {{ing:sugar-muscovado}}, {{ing:cinnamon-ground}} and {{ing:nutmeg}}.
Divide between two mugs with {{ing:cloves}}.
Add 50 ml of {{ing:spirit-40}} (dark rum) to each.
Top up with 150 ml hot water. Stir until melted.

swaps.text: Hot apple juice, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Yuzu and sake highball
recipes.method_note: Light, citrussy and Japanese: perfect with the Asian menus.

steps.instruction: Stir {{ing:sugar-caster}} into {{ing:yuzu-juice}} until dissolved.
Fill two tall glasses with ice. Add the yuzu.
Add 60 ml of {{ing:sake}} to each.
Top up with {{ing:sparkling-water}}. Add a slice of {{ing:lime}}.

swaps.text: Leave it out, for a yuzu soda

recipes.name: Passion fruit fizz martini
recipes.method_note: Tropical and glamorous, with a shot of fizz on the side.

steps.instruction: Scoop out {{ing:passion-fruit}}, keeping two halves to float.
Shake the pulp, {{ing:spirit-40}} (vanilla vodka), lime juice and {{ing:sugar-caster}} with ice.
Strain into two chilled glasses. Float a passion fruit half on each.
Serve {{ing:sparkling-wine}} in a shot glass alongside.

swaps.text: Shake with apple juice and top with soda, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Cranberry and rosemary shrub (no alcohol)
recipes.method_note: A shrub is a fruit vinegar syrup: sharp, complex and grown-up.

steps.instruction: Simmer {{ing:cranberries}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}} and {{ing:fresh-rosemary}} with 100 ml water until burst.
Add {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}} (cider vinegar is best). Cool. Strain.
Keep in the fridge for up to 2 weeks.
Pour 40 ml per glass over ice. Top up with {{ing:sparkling-water}}.

recipes.name: Spiced pear bellini
recipes.method_note: Softer than a peach bellini, warmly spiced.

steps.instruction: Simmer peeled, chopped {{ing:pear}} with {{ing:sugar-caster}}, {{ing:cinnamon-stick}}, {{ing:star-anise}} and 100 ml water 10 minutes.
Remove the spices. Blend until smooth. Chill.
Put 2 tbsp purée in each flute.
Top up slowly with {{ing:sparkling-wine}}, stirring once.

swaps.text: Sparkling elderflower, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Chai-spiced white hot chocolate
recipes.method_note: Cardamom, ginger and cinnamon in creamy white chocolate.

steps.instruction: Heat {{ing:milk-whole}} with crushed {{ing:cardamom}}, {{ing:cinnamon-stick}}, {{ing:cloves}}, {{ing:black-peppercorns}} and {{ing:ginger-ground}}.
Leave 10 minutes off the heat.
Strain. Warm again. Whisk in {{ing:white-chocolate}} until melted.
Pour into mugs.

swaps.text: Oat milk with vegan white chocolate, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Lychee, ginger and lime sparkler
recipes.method_note: Floral and fresh: a soft drink worth dressing up for.

steps.instruction: Blend {{ing:lychees}} with grated {{ing:ginger-fresh}} and the juice of {{ing:lime}}. Strain.
Divide between four glasses of ice.
Top up with {{ing:ginger-ale}}. Add {{ing:fresh-mint}}.

recipes.name: Mulled port with orange and star anise
recipes.method_note: Small glasses only: rich and strong.

steps.instruction: Pour {{ing:port}} and {{ing:grape-juice-red}} into a pan.
Add sliced {{ing:orange}}, {{ing:star-anise}}, {{ing:cinnamon-stick}} and {{ing:cloves}}.
Warm 10 minutes without boiling.
Serve in small glasses.

swaps.text: Check the label says vegan if you need it

recipes.name: Espresso tonic with orange
recipes.method_note: Bitter, bright and fizzy. A grown-up soft drink.

steps.instruction: Make two shots of espresso from {{ing:coffee-ground}}. Cool.
Fill two glasses with ice and {{ing:tonic-water}}.
Pour the espresso slowly over the back of a spoon so it floats.
Add a slice of {{ing:orange}}.

recipes.name: Maple and orange old fashioned
recipes.method_note: Stirred, not shaken: strong and smooth.

steps.instruction: Stir {{ing:spirit-40}} (bourbon or whisky) and {{ing:maple-syrup}} with ice for 30 seconds.
Add a few drops of bitters, if you have them.
Strain over a large ice cube in each glass.
Twist a strip of {{ing:orange}} peel over the top.

swaps.text: Cold black tea with maple and orange, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Mulled cranberry and pomegranate (no alcohol)
recipes.method_note: Deep red and spiced: the soft drink for the main course.

steps.instruction: Pour {{ing:cranberry-juice}} and {{ing:pomegranate-juice}} into a pan.
Add sliced {{ing:orange}} and {{ing:ginger-fresh}}, {{ing:cinnamon-stick}}, {{ing:cloves}} and {{ing:star-anise}}.
Warm 15 minutes without boiling.
Ladle into mugs.

recipes.name: Salted caramel espresso martini
recipes.method_note: The festive twist on the modern classic.

steps.instruction: Make 60 ml espresso from {{ing:coffee-ground}}. Stir in {{ing:dulce-de-leche}} and {{ing:salt}}. Cool.
Shake with {{ing:spirit-40}} (vodka), {{ing:orange-liqueur}} (coffee liqueur) and ice for 20 seconds.
Strain into two chilled glasses.

swaps.text: Shake the caramel coffee with oat milk and ice, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Chateaubriand for two with red wine jus
recipes.method_note: The thick centre of the fillet, carved at the table.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Season {{ing:beef-fillet}} well.
Sear in {{ing:olive-oil}} 6 minutes, turning, until browned all over.
Add {{ing:butter-block}}, {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:fresh-thyme}}. Baste 1 minute.
Roast 15 minutes for medium-rare. Rest 10 minutes.
Fry chopped {{ing:shallot}} in the pan. Add {{ing:wine-red}}. Boil until halved.
Add {{ing:stock-chicken}} and the resting juices. Boil 4 minutes.
Carve thickly. Pour over the jus.

swaps.text: More stock and 1 tsp redcurrant jelly, for no alcohol

recipes.name: Kerala halibut curry with coconut and curry leaves
recipes.method_note: Fragrant, tangy and golden: a South Indian Christmas.

steps.instruction: Heat {{ing:vegetable-oil}}. Add {{ing:mustard-seeds}}. When they pop, add {{ing:curry-leaves}}.
Fry sliced {{ing:onion-medium}} 8 minutes, until golden.
Add grated {{ing:garlic-clove}} and {{ing:ginger-fresh}}, {{ing:turmeric-ground}} and {{ing:chilli-powder}}. Stir 1 minute.
Add {{ing:coconut-milk-tinned}} and {{ing:tamarind-pulp}}. Simmer 10 minutes.
Cook {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}}.
Add chunks of {{ing:halibut}}. Poach 5 minutes, until flaking.
Serve with the rice.

swaps.text: Cod, hake or king prawns

recipes.name: Korean-style braised short ribs with kimchi rice
recipes.method_note: Sweet, savoury and sticky. Pear tenderises the meat, the Korean way.

steps.instruction: Blend {{ing:pear}}, {{ing:soy-sauce}}, {{ing:gochujang}}, {{ing:garlic-clove}}, {{ing:ginger-fresh}} and {{ing:sugar-muscovado}}.
Coat {{ing:beef-braising}} (short ribs). Marinate overnight.
Put in a casserole with 300 ml water. Cover. Braise at 150C 3 hours.
Uncover. Boil the sauce on the hob until sticky. Stir in {{ing:sesame-oil}}.
Cook {{ing:rice-jasmine-dry}}. Stir through chopped {{ing:kimchi}}.
Serve with sliced {{ing:spring-onion}} and {{ing:sesame-seeds}}.

swaps.text: Tamari and a gochujang labelled gluten free, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Cantonese ginger and spring onion lobster
recipes.method_note: A banquet dish from Hong Kong: fast, fragrant and glossy.

steps.instruction: Cut {{ing:lobster-tail}} through the shell into chunks. Dust with {{ing:cornflour}}.
Fry in hot {{ing:vegetable-oil}} 3 minutes, until red. Lift out.
Fry sliced {{ing:ginger-fresh}}, {{ing:garlic-clove}} and white parts of {{ing:spring-onion}} 1 minute.
Add {{ing:sake}} (Shaoxing wine), {{ing:oyster-sauce}}, {{ing:soy-sauce}} and {{ing:stock-chicken}}.
Return the lobster. Toss 2 minutes, until glossy. Add the green onion.
Serve over cooked {{ing:egg-noodles-dry}}.

swaps.text: Large shell-on king prawns

recipes.name: Tandoori-spiced whole side of salmon with mint raita
recipes.method_note: Smoky, spiced and vivid: a festive centrepiece with Indian flavours.

steps.instruction: Mix 100 g of {{ing:natural-yoghurt}} with {{ing:garam-masala}}, {{ing:smoked-paprika}} and {{ing:turmeric-ground}}.
Add grated {{ing:garlic-clove}}, {{ing:ginger-fresh}} and the juice of half of {{ing:lemon}}.
Spread over {{ing:salmon-fillet}}. Marinate 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 220C. Roast 18 minutes, until charred at the edges.
Grate {{ing:cucumber}}. Squeeze out the water.
Mix with the rest of the yoghurt and chopped {{ing:fresh-mint}} for the raita.
Serve with lemon wedges and the raita.

swaps.text: Coconut yoghurt, for a dairy-free version

recipes.name: Persian jewelled rice with saffron and pistachios
recipes.method_note: Golden crust (tahdig) on the bottom, jewels of fruit and nuts on top.

steps.instruction: Soak {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}} in salted water 1 hour. Drain.
Steep {{ing:saffron}} in 3 tbsp hot water.
Boil the rice with crushed {{ing:cardamom}} 6 minutes. Drain.
Melt half of {{ing:butter-block}} in a heavy pan. Pack in a layer of rice mixed with saffron.
Pile in the rest of the rice. Make holes with a spoon handle. Dot with butter.
Cover with a tea towel and lid. Cook on a low heat 40 minutes.
steps.note: The towel stops drips making the crust soggy.

steps.instruction: Simmer orange peel strips, chopped {{ing:dried-apricots}} and {{ing:dried-cranberries}} in water with {{ing:sugar-caster}} 5 minutes.
Turn out. Scatter the fruit, {{ing:pistachios}} and toasted {{ing:almonds}}.

swaps.text: Olive oil, for a vegan version

recipes.name: Truffle cacio e pepe
recipes.method_note: Three ingredients and technique: cheese, pepper and pasta water make the sauce.

steps.instruction: Cook {{ing:spaghetti-dry}} in less water than usual, so it is starchy.
Toast crushed {{ing:black-peppercorns}} in {{ing:butter-block}} 1 minute.
Add a ladle of pasta water. Add the drained pasta.
Off the heat, add finely grated {{ing:parmesan}} a handful at a time, tossing.
steps.note: Off the heat, or the cheese clumps.

steps.instruction: Add pasta water until creamy. Finish with {{ing:truffle-oil}}.

swaps.text: Use a vegetarian hard cheese (traditionally Pecorino)

recipes.name: Earl Grey and lemon posset with shortbread
recipes.method_note: Bergamot tea perfumes the cream.

steps.instruction: Warm {{ing:double-cream}} with {{ing:tea-bags}} (Earl Grey). Leave 10 minutes. Squeeze and remove.
Add {{ing:sugar-caster}}. Bring to the boil. Bubble 3 minutes.
Off the heat, stir in the zest and juice of {{ing:lemon}}.
Pour into 6 glasses. Chill 4 hours, until set.
Serve with {{ing:shortbread}}.

swaps.text: Gluten-free biscuits, for a gluten-free version

recipes.name: Yuzu and lime tart
recipes.method_note: Like a lemon tart, but floral and exotic.

steps.instruction: Line a 23 cm tin with {{ing:shortcrust-pastry}}. Bake blind at 190C 25 minutes.
Turn the oven to 150C.
Whisk {{ing:egg-medium}} and {{ing:sugar-caster}}. Whisk in {{ing:double-cream}}, {{ing:yuzu-juice}} and lime juice and zest.
Skim off any froth. Pour into the case.
Bake 30 minutes, until set with a wobble.
Cool. Dust with {{ing:icing-sugar}}.

swaps.text: All lime, or half lime, half grapefruit

recipes.name: Roast pears with white miso caramel and sesame
recipes.method_note: Sweet, salty and deeply savoury. A modern Japanese-inspired finish.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 200C. Halve and core {{ing:pear}}.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}} and {{ing:sugar-muscovado}} in an ovenproof pan. Add the pears cut side down.
Roast 20 minutes, until tender.
Lift out the pears. Whisk {{ing:miso-paste}} and {{ing:double-cream}} into the pan juices.
Bubble 2 minutes, until glossy.
Serve with {{ing:ice-cream-vanilla}}, the caramel and toasted {{ing:sesame-seeds}}.

swaps.text: A pinch of sea salt
Check the miso and ice cream labels

recipes.name: Chocolate, chilli and cinnamon pots (Mexican style)
recipes.method_note: A gentle warmth after the chocolate. Vegan and set in the fridge.

steps.instruction: Heat {{ing:coconut-cream}} with {{ing:cinnamon-ground}} and {{ing:cayenne-pepper}} until steaming.
Pour over chopped {{ing:dark-chocolate-70}}. Stir until glossy.
Stir in {{ing:maple-syrup}} and orange zest.
Pour into 6 small cups. Chill 3 hours.

swaps.text: Check the label says vegan if you need it

recipes.name: Crispy oyster sliders with lemon mayonnaise
recipes.method_note: New Orleans style: crunchy fried oysters in soft rolls.

steps.instruction: Drain {{ing:oysters}}. Pat dry.
Dust in {{ing:flour-plain}} with {{ing:cayenne-pepper}}, then beaten {{ing:egg-medium}}, then {{ing:panko}}.
Deep-fry in 5 cm of vegetable oil at 180C for 90 seconds, until golden.
steps.note: Nutrition counts only the oil the food soaks up.

steps.instruction: Mix {{ing:mayonnaise}} with the zest and juice of {{ing:lemon}}.
Split {{ing:brioche}} (4 rolls). Fill with {{ing:cos-lettuce}}, oysters and mayonnaise.

swaps.text: Large raw king prawns
